sum: This study introduces a hierarchical framework to govern and explain the depth-dependence and scaling laws of slow earthquakes. By addressing how physical properties change with depth, the model successfully reconciles observed scaling relationships of slow slip events, tremors, and low-frequency earthquakes, providing a unified theoretical foundation for slow rupture dynamics.

sum: This paper introduces transition-set morphometry to quantify inter-scale contacts in digital sandstones, treating pore volume, medial pore-throats, and fracture porosity as distinct geometric subsystems. The method measures transition-set density, finite-scale dimension, and weighted contact measures. Tested on 21 digital sandstone samples from the Imperial College micro-CT collection and the DRP-317 dataset, the adaptive contact measure combining transition-set density with local pore radius significantly improved permeability prediction (increasing leave-one-out R2 from 0.752 to 0.881 in the combined sample). Tests on fractured datasets (DRP-5, DRP-31, DRP-285) confirmed the successful transfer of this framework to fracture-related contacts, demonstrating its value as a reproducible morphometric descriptor for rock physics.
本文引入过渡集形态学方法来定量表征数字砂岩中的多尺度接触，将孔隙体积、介质孔喉子系统和裂缝孔隙度视为不同的几何子系统。该方法测量了过渡集的密度、有限尺度维数和加权接触测度。在帝国理工微CT和DRP-317数据集的21个数字砂岩样本上进行的测试表明，结合过渡集密度与局部孔隙半径的自适应接触测度显著提高……

sum: This paper presents a sequential receiver function (RF) and coda autocorrelation (AC) H-κ phase-weighted stacking method to simultaneously constrain sedimentary and crystalline crustal properties. Traditional RF methods struggle in sedimentary basins due to strong sediment-related multiples that contaminate deeper crustal signals. By integrating AC data, which provides independent constraints on P- and S-wave reflection times, the new method suppresses sediment multiple interference. Synthetic tests and real-world applications to four broadband stations in the Bohai Bay Basin and Tarim Basin, China, demonstrate its robustness. The results reveal 2.0–10.0 km thick sedimentary layers with depth-decreasing Vp/Vs ratios, and distinct crustal thicknesses (28.0–32.0 km in Bohai Bay versus ~40 km in Tarim), demonstrating the method's capability to resolve complex layered continental crust.
本文提出了一种顺序接收函数（RF）与柯达自相关（AC）H-κ相位加权堆叠方法，用于同时约束沉积层和下伏结晶地壳性质。传统RF方法在沉积盆地中易受强沉积多次波干扰。该方法通过引入AC数据，为P波和S波反射时间提供独立约束，从而有效压制多次波。合成测试和中国渤海湾盆地及塔里木盆地4个宽频带台站的实际应用……

sum: This paper proposes a multi-scale spatiotemporal inversion filter (MSIF) method for dense GNSS networks to extract transient tectonic signals from noisy time series. The method combines multi-scale spatial decomposition of regional deformation fields with a variational Bayesian Independent Component Analysis-based inversion. Applied to the 2021 Ms 6.4 Yangbi earthquake, MSIF successfully identified pre-seismic deformation anomalies concentrated at an 11 km scale. Inversion results show that the foreshock and mainshock rupture zones experienced extensional and right-lateral strike-slip motion, releasing an equivalent Mw 5.5 moment. This suggests that pre-seismic aseismic slip facilitated subsequent seismic ruptures.
本文提出了一种基于密集GNSS网络的多尺度时空反演滤波（MSIF）方法，用于从高噪声时间序列中提取瞬态构造信号。该方法结合了区域形变场的多尺度空间分解与变分贝叶斯独立成分分析反演。应用于2021年云南漾濞Ms 6.4级地震，MSIF成功识别出集中在11公里空间尺度上的震前形变异常。反演表明前震和主震……

sum: This study investigates a deep Mw=4.2 earthquake occurring beneath the Moho in southern Tibet. By precisely constraining its location, depth, and source mechanism using regional and teleseismic waveforms, the authors demonstrate that seismicity can persist in the sub-Moho mantle lithosphere under temperatures previously thought to inhibit brittle failure. This finding provides critical constraints on the rheology, thermal state, and mechanical behavior of the colliding Indian plate beneath Tibet, suggesting that the brittle-ductile transition or thermal limits of mantle rocks under high strain rates or dehydration conditions may need revision.
本研究对发生在藏南莫霍面下方的深源Mw 4.2地震进行了深入分析。通过利用区域和远震波形精确约束其定位、深度和震源机制，作者证明了在先前认为抑制脆性破裂的高温条件下，莫霍面以下的地幔岩石圈仍可发生地震。这一发现为西藏下方碰撞印度板块的流变学、热状态和力学行为提供了关键约束，表明在高应变率或脱水条件下……

sum: This study investigates mirror fault surfaces (MFS) and associated mineralogical changes within the Dinar Fault Zone in western Türkiye. The authors present evidence of earthquake-induced dolomite decarbonation, a chemical reaction triggered by localized frictional heating during high-velocity seismic slip. By analyzing the microstructures and mineral assemblages of the fault rocks, the study provides critical field-based constraints on the temperature rises and chemical processes that occur during seismic rupture in carbonate-bearing fault zones.
本研究调查了土耳其西部迪纳尔断裂带内的镜面断层表面（MFS）及相关的矿物学变化。作者提供了地震诱发白云石脱碳的证据，这是一种在高速地震滑动过程中由局部摩擦生热触发的化学反应。通过分析断层岩的微观结构和矿物组合，该研究为含碳酸盐断裂带在地震破裂期间的温度升高和化学过程提供了关键的野外约束。

t: Microstructural and mineralogical analysis of mirror fault surfaces (MFS) to identify high-temperature reaction products.

sum: This study presents high-resolution seismic imaging of the seismogenic fault zone responsible for three earthquakes in Luxian, Sichuan Basin, China. Utilizing data recorded by dense linear arrays and active methane gas gun sources, the authors successfully constrain the geometry of the fault and identify prominent low-velocity zones associated with the seismogenic structures. The integration of dense passive seismic monitoring and controlled active sources provides critical structural constraints to understand the fault mechanics and potential induced seismicity mechanisms in this highly active shale gas development region.

sum: This paper introduces a conjugate operator pair formulated as time-space partial differential equations (PDEs) for wave-equation Kirchhoff modeling and migration. This operator pair enables iterative linearized waveform inversion and reconstructs angle-dependent reflectivity images. The forward operator represents a full-wave formulation of the Kirchhoff-based upward-propagating operator, while its adjoint corresponds to angle-domain reverse time migration (RTM). Numerical tests on layered synthetic and field datasets demonstrate that this formulation matches two-way wave equation solutions and outperforms conventional Born and angle-degraded Kirchhoff modeling at large scattering angles, improving amplitude variation with angle (AVA) fidelity and spatial resolution.

sum: This paper investigates the computational aspects of an unsupervised clustering technique based on the correlation integral (CI) method. The authors derive two key parameters from the CI equation: the scaling exponent (SE) and its double derivative (DD), which serve as effective attributes for automated seismic data interpretation. The workflow successfully highlights geological features such as channels, gas chimneys, faults, and progradation clinoforms. By decreasing the calculation stride, the new workflow dramatically increases the resolution of SE and DD images with only a marginal increase in computation time. For the first time, these 3D volumes are converted to SEG-Y format for integration with professional interpretation software.

sum: This paper presents WaveFlowGMM, a novel two-stage probabilistic ground-motion model designed for performance-based seismic risk assessment. The framework decouples amplitude scaling and waveform shape generation using peak ground acceleration (PGA) as an interface. In the first stage, physics-informed symbolic learning estimates component-wise PGA medians and cross-component covariance. In the second stage, a few-step AlphaFlow model generates normalized three-component acceleration histories in an invertible wavelet-packet coefficient space, which are then rescaled by the sampled PGA. Evaluated on the NGA-West2 dataset, WaveFlowGMM successfully recovers magnitude, distance, and site scaling, preserves three-component amplitude dependence, and produces stable velocity and displacement histories without systematic drift upon integration.

sum: This study applies a machine-learning-based earthquake detection workflow to seismic data from the 2015–2016 KISS experiment to build an enhanced catalog for the Klyuchevskoy Volcanic Group (KVG) in Kamchatka. Detecting over 11,000 events (a 14-fold increase over manual catalogs), the authors use frequency index analysis and unsupervised clustering to separate long-period (LP) and volcano-tectonic (VT) events. The results reveal that LP events dominate the seismicity, forming deep-to-shallow conduits across crustal depths. Temporal analysis shows that deep LP activity precedes shallow seismicity, indicating magma or fluid pressure migration and providing new insights into multi-volcano seismic processes.

sum: This study introduces HARPA, a high-rate seismic phase association framework designed to handle dense, overlapping arrivals where local wave speeds are heterogeneous or poorly known. HARPA represents observed and predicted arrival sequences as probability distributions and compares them using an optimal-transport metric. It jointly estimates earthquake locations, origin times, and a low-dimensional representation of the wave-speed field using travel-time neural fields (neural networks mapping coordinates to travel times). While performing comparably to state-of-the-art associators on standard low-rate datasets, HARPA significantly outperforms existing methods under high-rate, laterally heterogeneous, or unknown wave-speed conditions. This adaptive travel-time modeling approach opens a new path toward joint phase association and passive-source seismic tomography.

sum: This study maps the present-day 2-D crustal stress field and seismic moment release in the Greater Permian Basin of Texas. By compiling previously published and newly determined focal mechanisms, the authors perform a 2-D stress inversion parameterized on a 0.15° x 0.1° grid, using a trade-off curve to optimize damping. The results reveal that while the basin generally exhibits an extensional stress regime, the orientations of the principal stress axes are highly heterogeneous across subprovinces (Delaware Basin, Central Basin Platform, and Midland Basin). This stress heterogeneity suggests that basement-rooted fault systems are subject to distinct stress regimes. Furthermore, using seismic moment release as a proxy for deformation, the authors propose that areas with high moment release represent pre-existing elastic strain reservoirs where long-term tectonic strains are being reactivated and released by fluid injection.
本研究利用收集和新测定的震源机制解，对德克萨斯州二叠纪盆地（包括特拉华盆地、中央盆地平台和米德兰盆地）进行了二维地壳应力反演与地震矩释放制图。反演采用0.15°×0.1°网格，并通过折衷曲线优化阻尼系数。结果表明，尽管盆地整体处于伸展应力场，但主应力轴方向存在显著的空间非均匀性，暗示不同子盆地及基底……

t: A 2-D stress inversion of grouped focal mechanisms on a 0.15° x 0.1° grid, regulated by a trade-off curve to optimize damping and achieve a smooth stress gradient.
在0.15°×0.1°网格上对震源机制解进行二维应力反演，并利用折衷曲线优化阻尼系数。

The Permian Basin exhibits a generally extensional stress field with highly heterogeneous principal stress orientations, indicating distinct stress regimes for different subprovinces and basement faults.

sum: This study utilizes full waveform modeling to investigate how bridgmanite fabric-induced seismic anisotropy creates mid-mantle discontinuities. Specifically, it explores the implications of these fabric-induced structures on double underside reflections of seismic waves beneath subduction zones, providing insights into mantle flow and mineral physics.

sum: This study evaluates the performance of regional 1D and 3D velocity models for seismic moment tensor (MT) estimation of the 2017 M6 Hojedk, Iran, earthquake sequence using the MTUQ software. By utilizing the 3D Middle East velocity model MEAD-M20, the authors demonstrate that for periods T ≥ 25–30 s and magnitudes Mw ≥ 4.5, 3D synthetics outperform 1D models by reducing waveform misfits, time shifts, and spurious non-double-couple components. Uncertainty analysis confirms that MT parameters, depth, and magnitude are more tightly constrained under the 3D model, validating its application for regional source characterization.

sum: This paper investigates the flow behavior and hydrodynamic characteristics of Newtonian and non-Newtonian fluids using the Brookfield DV3TLV viscometer. By comparing measurements with the high-precision Anton Paar MCR 302 rheometer, the authors determine empirical coefficients relating spindle rotational speed to shear rate across different geometries. The study validates the laminar flow assumption via Reynolds number analysis and establishes correction factors to estimate real fluid viscosity, providing a practical methodology for engineering and laboratory applications where high-end rheometers are unavailable.

sum: This paper addresses the challenge of converting distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) strain-rate measurements into geophone-equivalent particle velocity. Because DAS measures strain or strain rate, converting it requires inverting a spatial-difference operator, which often amplifies noise. To overcome the limitations of single-regularization methods, the authors propose a joint inverse reconstruction framework combining high-order Lp (HOLp) and overlapping group sparsity (OGS) regularizations. HOLp suppresses incoherent noise, while OGS preserves weak coherent events. The optimization problem is solved using the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM). Numerical and field experiments demonstrate that this method successfully restores amplitude and waveform fidelity under low signal-to-noise ratio conditions.
本文针对分布式声学传感（DAS）应变率测量向等效检波器质点速度转换中的噪声放大难题，提出了一种结合高阶Lp（HOLp）和重叠组稀疏（OGS）正则化的联合反演重构框架。HOLp用于压制非相干噪声，而OGS用于保留弱相干事件。该目标函数采用交替方向乘子法（ADMM）进行求解。数值和实际数据实验表明，该方……

t: An inverse reconstruction framework combining high-order Lp (HOLp) and overlapping group sparsity (OGS) regularizations, solved via the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM).

sum: This study presents a new suite of top-heavy geodynamo simulations that vary the relative strengths of thermal and chemical driving to investigate core-mantle interactions. By comparing simulated magnetic signatures with observational field models spanning centuries to tens of thousands of years, the authors find that spatially-averaged measures of field morphology cannot robustly distinguish chemical driving levels or boundary heat flux heterogeneity. However, longitudinal variations in time-averaged inclination anomalies are readily matched by simulations with heterogeneous outer boundary thermal forcing. Elevated chemical driving reduces but does not erase these longitudinal structures, while promoting polar minima in the radial magnetic field. The results suggest that both strong heat flux heterogeneity and chemical driving in Earth's core lead to small but persistent departures from the geocentric axial dipole approximation.

sum: This paper investigates the dynamic propagation of inclined cracks in slopes under seismic conditions. The authors propose an analytical fracture mechanics solution and validate it using a centrifuge shaking table test. The results demonstrate that seismic wave amplitude significantly accelerates crack propagation. Additionally, analysis of crack propagation and surface displacement reveals hysteresis and sudden jumps in surface deformation, which are attributed to the rock mass structure and locked segments. This study provides a valuable framework for integrating theoretical analytical solutions with experimental modeling to understand earthquake-induced landslide hazards.
本文研究了地震条件下边坡倾斜裂缝的动态扩展。作者提出了断裂力学解析解，并通过离心机振动台试验进行了验证。结果表明，地震波振幅显著加速了裂缝扩展。此外，对裂缝扩展和地表位移的分析揭示了由岩体结构和锁固段引起的地表变形滞后和突变现象。该研究为结合理论解析解与实验模拟来理解地震诱发的滑坡灾害提供了范例。

sum: This study presents updated plate kinematic models of Cenozoic plate divergence across the West Antarctic Rift System using high-resolution satellite altimeter data. The new models replicate the extent of subglacial extensional rift basins and the mid-Eocene (~45 Ma) maximum ages of associated magmatic rocks. Crucially, they do not support a Paleocene onset of intra-Antarctic divergence. This implies that the absolute motion of the Pacific plate changed very little around the time of the prominent ~47 Ma Hawaii-Emperor bend. Consequently, the cause of the bend is likely driven by the migration of the Hawaii hotspot relative to the mantle, rather than a sudden reorganization of Pacific plate motion.

sum: This study analyzes the 16 July 2025 Mw 7.3 earthquake in the Shumagin segment of the Alaska Peninsula. Using AI-enhanced seismic detection and relocation, the authors construct an E-W trending, south-dipping curved fault model. Joint inversion of teleseismic waveforms and GNSS data reveals a predominantly sinistral strike-slip mechanism with rupture confined beneath the subduction interface. Together with the 2020 Mw 7.6 event, it forms a conjugate fault system. The study demonstrates that both events are driven by stress perturbations from along-strike and along-dip variations in megathrust coupling, combined with slab pull and plate bending.

sum: This study utilizes a fiber-optic seismic array (Distributed Acoustic Sensing, DAS) near Bishop, California, to image the subsurface structure of the Owens Valley rift basin. By recording apparent Ps converted phases and combining them with ambient noise cross-correlation, the authors perform a joint inversion for the local velocity structure. They successfully replicate the proposed depth of the North Bishop Block, a 100-square-kilometer slumped block from the White Mountains. Furthermore, they identify a deeper phase-converting interface to the south, interpreted as a previously unmapped slumped block at approximately 1 km depth. This work advances the application of converted phases in fiber-optic seismology and provides critical insights into the tectonic history and hydrology of the region.

sum: This study investigates the coseismic surface rupture zone widths (RZWs) of the 2021 Mw 7.4 Maduo strike-slip earthquake in the Tibetan Plateau using high-resolution drone orthoimages. By measuring RZWs at 100 m intervals along the ~148 km rupture, the authors show that while local RZWs are influenced by fault geometry and soil conditions, macroscopic RZW distributions reflect dynamic rupture processes. West of the epicenter, RZWs increase with propagation distance due to growing off-fault energy dissipation. East of the epicenter, a distinct narrowing of the RZW indicates a supershear transition triggered by an extensional fault bend. The study highlights the potential of surface rupture widths to record earthquake dynamic rupture history.
本研究利用高分辨率无人机正射影像，对青藏高原2021年Mw 7.4玛多走滑地震约148公里地表破裂带进行了100米间隔的破裂带宽度（RZW）测量。结果表明，尽管局部破裂带宽度受断层几何复杂性和覆土条件影响，但宏观破裂带宽度分布反映了地震动力学破裂过程。震中以西，破裂带宽度随传播距离增加而变宽，与非断……

t: High-resolution drone photogrammetry and systematic measurement of surface rupture zone widths at 100 m intervals along the ~148 km strike-slip fault trace.
利用高分辨率无人机摄影测量，沿约148公里的走滑断层走向以100米间隔系统测量地表破裂带宽度。
High-resolution (4-8 cm per pixel) drone orthoimages covering the ~148 km surface rupture of the 2021 Mw 7.4 Maduo earthquake in the Tibetan Plateau.
覆盖青藏高原2021年Mw 7.4玛多地震约148公里地表破裂带的高分辨率（4-8厘米/像素）无人机正射影像。
RZW increases with propagation distance in Segments 1-2, narrows significantly in Segment 3 due to a supershear transition, and widens in Segment 4 due to fault roughness and rupture termination.
破裂带宽度在第1-2段随传播距离增加，在第3段因超剪切转变显著变窄，在第4段因断层粗糙度增加而变宽。
Local surface RZWs are influenced by superficial soil conditions (thickness and fracture toughness) and local fault geometric complexities.
局部地表破裂带宽度易受表层土壤条件（厚度与断裂韧性）及局部断层几何复杂性的干扰。
Demonstrating that macroscopic coseismic surface rupture zone width distributions systematically record earthquake dynamic rupture history, including supershear transitions.
首次系统证明了宏观同震地表破裂带宽度分布能够有效记录地震动力学破裂过程及超剪切转变。

Demonstrated that macroscopic RZW distributions can be used to reconstruct earthquake dynamic rupture processes.

证明了宏观破裂带宽度分布可用于重建地震动力学破裂过程。
识别出由拉张断层弯曲触发的超剪切破裂转变所导致的破裂带宽度显著变窄特征。

Systematic measurement of surface rupture zone widths (RZWs) at 100 m intervals along the fault trace.
利用高分辨率无人机摄影测量（每像素4-8厘米的正射影像）进行地表破裂制图。
沿断层走向以100米为间隔系统测量地表破裂带宽度（RZW）。

覆盖2021年Mw 7.4玛多地震破裂带第1至第4段（约148公里）的高分辨率无人机正射影像数据。

sum: This study presents new geochemical, isotopic (Sr-Nd-Pb), and geochronological (40Ar/39Ar and K-Ar) data from the Transminas and Pirenópolis dike swarms in Brazil. The low-Ti Pirenópolis dikes yield Triassic ages (~210.7–205.5 Ma), linking them to the Central Atlantic Magmatic Province (CAMP). Conversely, high-Ti dikes from both swarms yield Early Cretaceous ages (~133–131.5 Ma), coeval with the Paraná–Etendeka Magmatic Province (PEMP) and the breakup of West Gondwana. These high-Ti tholeiites show enriched mantle signatures (EMI) and share source reservoirs with the Equatorial Atlantic Magmatic Province (EQUAMP), supporting their integration into the South Atlantic Magmatic Province (SAMP). The spatial distribution suggests the Transbrasiliano Lineament acted as a major tectonic boundary modulating Mesozoic magmatism.
本研究提供了巴西Transminas和Pirenópolis岩墙群的新地球化学、同位素（Sr-Nd-Pb）和地质年代学（40Ar/39Ar和K-Ar）数据。低钛Pirenópolis岩墙群测年为三叠纪（~210.7-205.5 Ma），与中大西洋火成岩省（CAMP）相关；而两者的超高钛岩墙群则记录了……

对岩墙样品进行地质年代学（40Ar/39Ar、K-Ar）和地球化学/同位素（Sr-Nd-Pb）分析。
Rock samples from the Transminas and Pirenópolis dike swarms in southeastern and central Brazil.

Low-Ti dikes yield Triassic ages (~210.7-205.5 Ma; CAMP), while high-Ti dikes yield Early Cretaceous ages (~133-131.5 Ma; PEMP/SAMP).
低钛岩墙呈三叠纪年龄（~210.7-205.5 Ma），高钛岩墙呈早白垩世年龄（~133-131.5 Ma）。
Geochemical and geochronological interpretations are limited to the sampled exposures of the dike swarms.
地球化学和年代学解释受限于岩墙群的实际出露和采样范围。
Linking the high-Ti dikes to the South Atlantic Magmatic Province and identifying the Transbrasiliano Lineament as a key tectonic boundary modulating Mesozoic magmatism.
将高钛岩墙与南大西洋火成岩省联系起来，并指出Transbrasiliano断裂带是控制中生代岩浆作用的关键构造边界。

Determined Early Cretaceous ages (~133–131.5 Ma) for high-Ti dikes, associating them with the Paraná–Etendeka Magmatic Province (PEMP) and South Atlantic Magmatic Province (SAMP).
Demonstrated that the Transbrasiliano Lineament acted as a major tectonic boundary modulating the spatial distribution of Mesozoic magmatism.
确定了低钛Pirenópolis岩墙群的三叠纪年龄（~210.7-205.5 Ma），将其与中大西洋火成岩省（CAMP）联系起来。
确定了高钛岩墙群的早白垩世年龄（~133-131.5 Ma），将其与巴拉那-伊滕德卡火成岩省（PEMP）及南大西洋火成岩省（SAMP）联系起来。
证明了Transbrasiliano断裂带作为主要构造边界，调节了中生代大火成岩省的侵位空间分布。

Geochemical major and trace element analysis.
Sr, Nd, and Pb isotopic composition analysis to characterize mantle sources.

地球化学主量和微量元素分析。

sum: This review paper synthesizes how the dynamic, two-way feedback between bacterial activity (motility, growth, and sensing) and the heterogeneous, opaque structure of soil governs biophysical processes. It spans three distinct spatial scales: the single pore, the mesoscale of multiple pores, and the broader landscape scale. The authors highlight how bacteria not only respond to their physical and chemical environments but actively reshape them, a crucial coupling often overlooked in idealized experiments and models.
该综述探讨了细菌活动（运动、生长和感知）与异质、不透明土壤结构之间的双向动态反馈机制。文章跨越了三个空间尺度：单孔隙尺度、多孔隙介观尺度以及宏观景观尺度。作者强调了细菌不仅响应其物理和化学环境，还会主动重塑环境，这一关键的耦合作用在以往的理想化实验和理论模型中经常被忽视。

t: Literature review and multi-scale synthesis of biophysical and soil science studies.
对生物物理和土壤科学研究进行文献综述与多尺度综合分析。
Synthesized literature data spanning single-pore, mesoscale, and landscape observations of soil-bacterial systems.
综合了涵盖单孔隙、介观和景观尺度的土壤-细菌系统文献数据。
Conceptual framework showing that two-way feedback between bacteria and soil governs motility, growth, and sensing across scales.
提出了细菌与土壤双向反馈控制其跨尺度运动、生长和感知的概念框架。
Does not introduce new experimental datasets or numerical models.
未引入新的实验数据集或数值模型。
Focuses specifically on the active, two-way feedback loop where bacteria reshape their soil environment across multiple scales.
重点关注细菌在多个尺度上主动重塑其土壤环境的双向反馈循环。

Highlights the two-way feedback where bacteria actively reshape their heterogeneous soil environments.
Identifies key gaps in idealized experiments and theories regarding soil-bacterial interactions.

强调了细菌主动重塑其异质土壤环境的双向反馈机制。
指出了以往理想化实验和理论在土壤-细菌相互作用研究中的关键空白。
me: Literature review and synthesis of biophysical, ecological, and soil science studies across scales.

无新实验数据；综合了现有的关于土壤-细菌相互作用的观测与理论文献。

sum: This paper develops a three-dimensional analytical two-degree-of-freedom (2DOF) model to describe the bounded rocking response of free-standing rigid square columns under bidirectional seismic excitation. Extending Housner's planar theory, the model incorporates energy dissipation via instantaneous inelastic impacts during edge-to-corner transitions based on angular momentum conservation. Numerical simulations using 176 near-fault, pulse-like ground motions reveal that square columns dissipate more energy and exhibit superior stability compared to cylindrical columns due to strong coupling and impact-induced damping.
本文开发了一个三维解析双自由度（2DOF）模型，用于描述双向地震激励下自立式刚性方形柱的受限摇摆响应。该模型扩展了Housner的经典平面理论，基于角动量守恒引入了边缘与角部过渡期间瞬时非弹性碰撞的能量耗散机制。通过176个近断层脉冲型地震动模拟表明，方形柱比圆柱具有更强的耗能能力和更高的抗震稳定性……

t: A 3D analytical 2DOF model extending Housner's planar theory, incorporating three impact mechanisms based on angular momentum conservation.
扩展Housner平面理论的三维解析双自由度模型，结合了基于角动量守恒的三种碰撞机制。
Numerical simulations using 176 near-fault, pulse-like ground motions to compare square and cylindrical columns.
使用176条近断层脉冲型地震动对方形和圆形柱进行对比的数值模拟。
Square columns dissipate more energy and exhibit superior seismic stability compared to cylindrical columns.
与圆柱相比，方形柱表现出更高的能量耗散和更优越的抗震稳定性。
Assumes rigid-body column behavior and constrains motion to the original footprint without sliding.
假定为刚体行为，且限制在原始基底内摇摆，不考虑滑动。
First 3D analytical 2DOF model for square columns capturing edge-to-corner impact transitions and coupling.
首次提出能捕捉边缘-角部碰撞过渡及耦合效应的方形柱三维解析双自由度模型。

kc: Developed a novel 3D analytical 2DOF model for the rocking response of free-standing square columns.
Formulated three distinct impact mechanisms for transitions between edges and corners based on angular momentum conservation.
Demonstrated through statistical analysis that square columns are more stable and dissipate more energy than cylindrical columns under bidirectional seismic excitation.
开发了自立式方形柱摇摆响应的新型三维解析双自由度（2DOF）模型。

构建捕捉静止、边缘摇摆和角部摇摆之间过渡的数值积分框架。

sum: This study investigates the 2025 Mw 7.6 Aomori megathrust earthquake in Northeast Japan. The paper demonstrates that the earthquake resulted from the failure of a distinct seismic asperity that is structurally and rheologically bounded. Located beneath a cold mantle wedge, the spatial extent and rupture behavior of this event were tightly constrained by the local thermal structure and material properties of the plate interface, highlighting the role of deep slab-wedge interactions in controlling large subduction zone earthquakes.
本研究分析了日本东北部2025年Mw 7.6青森板块俯冲带大地震。研究表明，该地震是由一个在结构和流变学上受限的闭锁段（asperity）破裂引起的。该闭锁段位于寒冷的地幔楔下方，其空间范围和破裂行为受到局部热结构及板块边界介质属性的严格控制，揭示了深部板块-地幔楔相互作用对大地震的控制机制。

t: Seismic source inversion and rupture process imaging combined with thermal-rheological modeling of the subduction interface.
结合震源破裂过程反演与俯冲带界面的热-流变学数值模拟。
Seismic waveforms and structural/geophysical models of the Northeast Japan subduction zone.
日本东北俯冲带的地震波形数据及深部结构与地球物理模型。
The Mw 7.6 earthquake ruptured a bounded asperity beneath the cold mantle wedge, showing strong structural and rheological controls.
Mw 7.6地震破裂了冷地幔楔下方一个受结构和流变学严格控制的闭锁区。
Potential limitations in offshore resolution and simplified rheological assumptions for the deep plate interface.
深部板块边界的离岸分辨率限制以及流变学模型的简化假设。
Linking the rupture limits of the 2025 Aomori earthquake directly to the structural and rheological boundaries of a cold mantle wedge.
首次将2025年青森地震的破裂边界与冷地幔楔的结构及流变学边界直接联系起来。

Identified that the seismogenic asperity is structurally and rheologically bounded by the cold mantle wedge.
Elucidated the influence of deep subduction zone thermal structure on megathrust rupture limits.
表征了2025年Mw 7.6青森俯冲带大地震的破裂过程和震源参数。
确定了发震闭锁段在结构和流变学上受到寒冷地幔楔的边界限制。
阐明了深部俯冲带热结构对大地震破裂边界的影响。

Integration of thermal-rheological modeling with seismic observations to define asperity boundaries.

sum: This study presents a high-resolution (0.02° x 0.02°) probabilistic seismic hazard assessment (PSHA) for the Palghar district in Maharashtra, India, which has experienced frequent earthquake swarms since November 2018. The analysis accounts for the non-uniform spatial distribution of earthquake probability within seismic source zones and utilizes a data-driven approach to select and weight Ground Motion Prediction Equations (GMPEs). The resulting hazard maps for Peak Ground Acceleration (PGA) and Pseudo Spectral Acceleration (PSA) at 0.2 s and 1.0 s (for 10% and 2% probability of exceedance in 50 years) show significant spatial variations and improvements over previous regional models, providing critical inputs for earthquake-resistant design.
本研究针对印度马哈拉施特拉邦帕尔哈尔地区自2018年11月以来频繁发生的地震活动，开展了0.02°高分辨率概率地震危险性分析（PSHA）。该研究考虑了地震源区内地震发生概率的空间非均匀分布，并采用数据驱动方法筛选和加权地面运动预测方程（GMPEs）。计算得到了50年超越概率10%和2%条件下的峰值加……

t: Probabilistic seismic hazard assessment (PSHA) incorporating spatially non-uniform seismicity and data-driven selection of Ground Motion Prediction Equations (GMPEs).
结合空间非均匀地震活动性与数据驱动地面运动预测方程（GMPEs）筛选的概率地震危险性分析（PSHA）。
Regional earthquake catalog data for the Palghar district, Maharashtra, India, focusing on the swarm activity since November 2018.
印度马哈拉施特拉邦帕尔哈尔地区的区域地震目录数据，重点关注2018年11月以来的群震活动。
High-resolution hazard maps of PGA and PSA (0.2 s, 1.0 s) for 10% and 2% PoE in 50 years, finding a PGA of 0.15 g for DBE at the local atomic power plant.

The study's reliance on historical and recent swarm catalog completeness to characterize long-term non-uniform seismicity rates.

First high-resolution (0.02° grid) PSHA for Palghar incorporating both spatially non-uniform source probabilities and data-driven GMPE selection.
首次在帕尔哈尔地区开展结合空间非均匀震源概率和数据驱动GMPE筛选的0.02°高分辨率PSHA。

Implemented a data-driven selection and weighting scheme for Ground Motion Prediction Equations (GMPEs).

sum: This study utilizes a differential evolution (DE) algorithm with a novel hybrid mutation operator to calibrate the seismic design response spectrum for China. Using strong ground motion records with destructive power exceeding Chinese seismic intensity 7, the authors calibrate spectral parameters and compare them with the Code for Seismic Design of Buildings (CSDB2010). The results show that the average site characteristic period (Tg) for rock and hard soil conditions is larger than specified in CSDB2010 and increases with seismic intensity. Additionally, the average attenuation index (γ) is greater than the code values, while the average spectra platform value (βmax) approaches the code value at higher intensities.

sum: This study introduces an alternative numerical methodology to evaluate soil-structure interaction (SSI) modeling strategies in 3D concrete arch dams. By tracking mechanical energy decay during the free-vibration phase following seismic excitation, the authors isolate damping characteristics from continuous input. Using a 3D double-curvature arch dam model subjected to two distinct earthquake records, they extract the dominant structural frequency and energy decay coefficient across three foundation stiffness classes. Incorporating viscous boundaries yielded field-consistent effective damping ratios (7.77% to 10.72%) and increased the energy decay coefficient by 18% to 51% compared to traditional massless foundation models, demonstrating that seismic damping is highly dynamic and governed by foundation impedance.

sum: This study investigates the seismic expression of the 410 km discontinuity by coupling a grain-scale olivine-wadsleyite growth model with compressible mantle simulations of plumes and slabs. By varying kinetic parameters across seven orders of magnitude, the authors demonstrate a thermal asymmetry: high temperatures in plumes maintain a sharp 410 km discontinuity regardless of kinetics, whereas cold temperatures in subducting slabs make kinetics a first-order control. Three distinct regimes emerge in slabs: quasi-equilibrium (narrow, uplifted 410), intermediate rates (broad, deep 410 with metastable olivine wedges), and ultra-sluggish rates (slab stagnation with deeply displaced 410). Rheological feedbacks further modulate these kinetic effects. This work establishes the 410 km discontinuity as a key seismological constraint on upper mantle kinetic processes.
本研究将微观相变模型与地幔动力学模拟结合，探究410km不连续面特征。研究发现地幔柱高温使410界面保持尖锐，而俯冲带低温使相变动力学成为主导。俯冲带中存在准平衡、中等速率（产生亚稳态楔）和极慢速率（导致板块滞留）三种状态，且受流变反馈调制。该成果将410km间断面确立为约束上地幔动力学过程的重要指……

t: Coupling a grain-scale, interface-controlled olivine-wadsleyite growth model to compressible geodynamic simulations of mantle plumes and subducting slabs.

Synthetic geodynamic simulations of mantle plumes and subducting slabs with kinetic parameters varied across seven orders of magnitude.

Relies on idealized numerical simulations and simplified mineral physics parameters that may not capture full 3D mantle complexity.
依赖于理想化的数值模拟和简化的矿物物理参数，可能未完全捕捉三维地幔复杂性。
First study to directly couple grain-scale phase transition kinetics to compressible geodynamic models to quantify 410 km discontinuity sensitivity.

sum: This paper introduces '2D SuPPSALA' (2D SUbsurface Profiling via Passive Surface-wave data Analysis from Linear Arrays), an efficient method for reconstructing 2D shear-wave velocity (VS) structures. By combining surface-wave dispersion from moving subarrays of a linear array with station-specific spectral ratios in a joint inversion framework, the method overcomes depth penetration limits and non-uniqueness. It can be deployed using 3-component nodes or vertical/transverse cabled systems. The approach is demonstrated in a perilagoon environment in northeastern Italy, successfully imaging palaeodunes and peat-filled palaeochannels. The resulting VS model is validated by independent electromagnetic data, showing that 2D SuPPSALA provides enhanced depth sensitivity and simpler field operations compared to conventional active-source or roll-along techniques.
本文提出了一种名为2D SuPPSALA的高效二维剪切波速度（VS）成像方法。该方法在统一的联合反演框架下，将线性台阵移动子阵的被动面波频散与单台谱比相结合，克服了传统单观测值的非唯一性和深度探测限制。该技术可利用三分量地震节点或有线系统实现。在意大利东北部滨海潟湖环境的应用中，该方法成功重建了古沙……

sum: This study presents a three-dimensional electrical resistivity model of the North China Craton (NCC) using a magnetotelluric (MT) array. By applying thermodynamic and petrophysical equations, the authors estimate temperature and melt fraction to investigate lithospheric destruction. The model reveals two distinct low-resistivity anomaly systems separated by the resistive Taihang Uplift. The Western Block's localized anomalies are attributed to partial melting, water, and carbon dioxide, influenced by Cenozoic far-field effects of the Tibetan Plateau uplift. Conversely, the Eastern Block's anomalies are driven by Mesozoic Paleo-Pacific subduction and retreat, with the Tanlu Fault Zone acting as a melt conduit. This demonstrates that the NCC underwent a heterogeneous, multi-stage destruction process.
本研究利用大地电磁（MT）阵列构建了华北克拉通（NCC）的三维电阻率模型，并结合物理化学方程定量估算了温度和熔体体积分数。结果显示，被高阻太行隆起分隔的东、西部陆块呈现出不同的低阻异常特征。西部陆块的局部低阻异常由部分熔融、水和二氧化碳共同导致，受新生代青藏高原隆升的远场旋转效应控制；东部陆块的异常……

sum: This study evaluates the performance of the Earthquake Point-Source Integrated Code (EPIC) algorithm, used in the ShakeAlert system, for earthquake early warning (EEW) in Alaska's complex tectonic environment. Using a dataset of 530 moderate-to-large earthquakes (M 4.5–8.2, depths 1–212 km), the authors conducted simulated real-time replays. EPIC successfully detected 345 events, showing high reliability in high station density areas like Southcentral Alaska. However, a major performance gap was identified for deep earthquakes (>100 km), where initial magnitudes were underestimated by an average of 0.71 units (compared to 0.18 for shallow events). This error stems from EPIC's fixed 8 km depth assumption, which distorts station distance calculations. The study highlights the need for a hypocenter depth correction factor and establishes a baseline for expanding EEW to Alaska.

t: Simulated real-time replay of historical seismic waveforms using the EPIC point-source earthquake early warning algorithm to evaluate detection, location, and magnitude estimation.

Waveforms and metadata from 530 moderate-to-large Alaska earthquakes (M 4.5 to 8.2, depths 1 to 212 km) spanning various tectonic regimes.

sum: This Zenodo dataset contains local earthquake focal mechanism solutions for Macquarie Island, compiled by Yingbo Li and Nicholas Rawlinson. The data includes parameters such as longitude, latitude, depth, strike, dip, rake, magnitude, and event ID, with a separate file (MT-macq-lq.txt) designated for lower-quality focal mechanisms. It serves as a valuable resource for studying the active tectonics, stress field, and fault mechanics of the Macquarie Ridge Complex.
该Zenodo数据集提供了麦夸里岛（Macquarie Island）本地地震的震源机制解。数据由Yingbo Li和Nicholas Rawlinson整理，包含经纬度、深度、走向、倾角、滑动角、震级和事件ID等参数，并专门用一个文件存储较低质量的震源机制。该数据集为研究麦夸里脊复杂的活动构造、应……

sum: This study investigates the relationship between deep magma transport and surface volcanic unrest at Laguna del Maule, Chile. Using seismic imaging and deformation data, the authors identify upper and lower crustal magma reservoirs connected by a zone of deep crustal seismicity. They highlight a pronounced one-day seismic swarm in 2018 that occurred approximately three months before an observed increase in surface uplift rate. This lag is interpreted as the time required for new melt injected from the deep reservoir to propagate and pressurize the shallow reservoir, potentially controlled by hydraulic diffusivity. The findings demonstrate that volcanic unrest can initiate deep within the crust months before shallow geodetic signals become apparent, providing critical insights for volcano monitoring and hazard mitigation.
本研究探讨智利茂莱湖深部岩浆运移与地表火山活动的关系。结合地震与形变观测，发现连接上下地壳岩浆库的深部地震带。2018年一次显著的单日地震群发生约3个月后，地表隆起速率增加。研究推断该地震群由深部向浅部运移的新熔体注入驱动，时间滞后受浅部岩浆库水力扩散率控制。表明火山活动异常始于深部，比地表信号早数……

t: Joint analysis of deep crustal seismicity and surface geodetic deformation to track transcrustal magma transport.
联合分析深部地壳地震活动与地表大地测量形变，以追踪跨地壳岩浆运移。
Seismic swarm catalog from 2018 and surface uplift rate measurements at Laguna del Maule, Chile.
智利茂莱湖2018年的地震群目录及地表隆起速率测量数据。
A deep seismic swarm in 2018 preceded an increase in surface uplift rate by approximately 3 months.
2018年的一次深部地震群比地表隆起速率的增加提前了约3个月。
The hydraulic diffusivity model relies on simplified assumptions of crustal permeability and fluid properties.

Establishes a direct temporal link and physical mechanism connecting deep transcrustal magma transport to delayed surface unrest.
建立了连接深部跨地壳岩浆运移与延迟地表活动的直接时间联系和物理机制。

kc: Demonstrated a clear temporal link (3-month lag) between deep crustal seismicity and shallow volcanic uplift at Laguna del Maule.
Mapped the transcrustal pathway connecting upper and lower crustal magma reservoirs using seismicity.
Proposed hydraulic diffusivity within the upper crustal reservoir as the mechanism controlling the delay in surface deformation.
证实了茂莱湖深部地壳地震活动与浅部火山隆起之间存在明确的时间关联（3个月滞后）。

me: Seismic monitoring and location of deep crustal earthquake swarms.
Analysis of surface deformation/uplift rates (likely GNSS or InSAR).
Hydraulic diffusion modeling to explain the lag time between deep injection and surface uplift.

sum: This study utilizes shear-wave splitting of SKS and PKS (XKS) phases from Phase 2 of the WA Array in Western Australia to investigate why certain stations yield few splitting results despite pervasive regional anisotropy. The authors demonstrate that XKS energy is minimized when the raypath aligns with the event's nodal plane. This alignment frequently occurs for earthquakes in South America and the Aleutians, which are primary source zones for Western Australia. The resulting reduction in XKS energy hinders splitting measurements, explaining the historical lack of observations. The study highlights that a lack of XKS splitting does not necessarily indicate isotropic or weakly anisotropic media, emphasizing the importance of considering focal mechanisms in shear-wave splitting productivity.
本研究利用西澳大利亚WA Array二期台阵的SKS和PKS（XKS）剪切波分裂数据，探讨了在存在区域各向异性的情况下，部分台站分裂观测结果稀少的原因。研究发现，当射线路径与震源球节面方向一致时，XKS能量会降至最低。对于西澳接收的主要震源区（南美和阿留申群岛），这种节面重合频繁发生。能量衰减严重影……

XKS energy is minimized when raypaths align with event nodal planes, significantly reducing splitting measurement productivity for South American and Aleutian events.

The analysis is demonstrated primarily for Western Australia's specific source-receiver geometry and relies on teleseismic focal mechanism accuracy.

Demonstrates that focal mechanism radiation patterns, rather than structural isotropy, can cause a lack of shear-wave splitting measurements.

Explained the historical lack of shear-wave splitting measurements in Western Australia despite pervasive E-W to NE-SW anisotropic fabrics.

sum: This study evaluates the feasibility of implementing a network-based Earthquake Early Warning System (EEWS) at the Northeastern Italy Thrust Faults Observatory (NITRO). Using the probabilistic algorithm PRESTo, the authors perform extensive numerical simulations incorporating real station latencies measured over six months, alongside offline replays of the 2024 Mw 4.1 Preone earthquake. They find that the current network configuration results in a blind zone radius exceeding 18–25 km, which covers about half of the historically damaged sites. Consequently, actionable lead times are limited for local events, though the system remains highly valuable for rapid post-event information and situational awareness.

sum: This study utilizes two underwater distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) arrays—an 11 km cable in the Foziling reservoir and a 20 km offshore seafloor cable near Yantai—to characterize ship-associated wavefields and their interaction with background surface gravity waves (SGW). The authors identify mechanical, propeller-related, and 2–10 Hz hydrodynamic noise. Frequency-wavenumber analysis reveals energy enhancements at specific frequency bands (0.09–1.25 Hz in the reservoir, 1.3–1.6 Hz offshore) when ships cross the cables. These enhancements are attributed to second-order nonlinear interactions between ship-driven hydrodynamic forcing and background SGW, depending on their relative propagation directions. This work provides new insights into waveway transportation dynamics and underwater DAS wavefield complexity.

t: Frequency-wavenumber (f-k) analysis and spectral characterization of underwater DAS data to separate ship-associated mechanical, propeller, and hydrodynamic wavefields.
利用频率-波数（f-k）分析和谱表征方法，对水下DAS数据进行处理，分离船舶相关的机械、螺旋桨及流体动力学波场。

sum: This study investigates the mineralogical origin of the sporadic splitting of the 520-km mantle discontinuity (the 560-km reflector) using high pressure-temperature experiments (~20 GPa, 1200–1600 °C). The authors demonstrate that the addition of subducted carbonates to oceanic crust drives Ca-Mg exchange with silicates, promoting the exsolution of davemaoite (CaSiO3) to 12–33 vol.%. This high concentration of davemaoite produces a 2–4% shear-wave impedance contrast, matching seismic observations beneath subduction zones and mantle plumes. The findings provide a direct mineralogical link between deep carbon cycling and mantle seismic heterogeneity, showing how subducted volatiles shape the chemical stratification of the Earth's transition zone.

sum: This study analyzes four months of continuous seismic data from two stations near the 2019 Ridgecrest earthquake sequence using hierarchical clustering on deep scattering coefficients. To mitigate strong class imbalance from anthropogenic noise, the authors introduce three refinement strategies, including defining latent-space geometry using nighttime data. The unsupervised single-station approach successfully detects several localized, swarm-like seismic episodes preceding the Mw 6.4 foreshock on July 4, 2019. These weak events are absent from the standard reference catalog, suggesting localized, possibly off-fault seismicity. The work demonstrates that unsupervised single-station analysis can effectively complement traditional network-based earthquake catalogs for detecting weak seismicity.

sum: This paper investigates the impact of elevated sea levels on global seismicity. By analyzing global earthquake catalogs and sea-level data, the study aims to understand how ocean loading and unloading processes influence stress changes along coastal and submarine fault zones. The research addresses a critical gap in environmental seismology, exploring whether climate-induced sea-level rise could modulate tectonic activity and alter seismic hazards on a global scale.

sum: This paper introduces MorphoGP, a data-driven framework designed to predict equilibrium beach profiles (EBPs) under tidal influence. To handle complex wave-tide-sediment interactions, MorphoGP first uses a contrastive learning-based ContourCluster model to automatically classify beach morphologies. For each category, a specialized Gaussian process (GP) expert models the relationships between environmental factors (waves, tides, sediments) and profile shapes. A Gating Net then probabilistically aggregates these expert predictions. Evaluated on over 180 beach profiles along the Chinese coast, MorphoGP significantly outperforms conventional and deep learning baselines, reducing the test RMSE by 59.3% to 0.297 m. This framework offers a robust, non-parametric tool for coastal management and shoreline protection.

sum: This study applies a joint inversion of P- and S-wave travel times and local earthquake parameters to image the subsurface of Soufrière Hills Volcano, Montserrat. By analyzing seismic velocities, Vp/Vs ratios, and hypocenter distributions, the authors identify a subvolcanic, fluid-saturated, and potentially metal-rich brine lens at depths of 2–3 km. The results also image previously confirmed shallower geothermal systems. This work demonstrates the capability of seismic tomography to characterize magmatic brine lenses, which are critical for understanding both volcanic hazards and the formation of magmatic-hydrothermal ore deposits.

sum: This computational study investigates the effect of off-fault Mohr-Coulomb plasticity on the propagation speed of elongated, width-limited strike-slip earthquake ruptures. Using a 2.5D (width-averaged) modeling approach, the authors show that off-fault inelastic deformation prevents rupture acceleration to theoretical limits, instead stabilizing steady pulse-like ruptures at speeds between 6.5% and 99% of the Rayleigh wave speed. A systematic parametric study characterizes how these steady speeds depend on initial fault stress, proximity to plastic failure, and seismogenic zone width. The findings demonstrate that off-fault plasticity is a viable mechanism for explaining realistic earthquake rupture velocities (including slow tsunami earthquakes) on planar faults with homogeneous stress, while providing insights into pulse width, peak slip velocity, and inelastic zone width.

sum: This study addresses the inconsistency between seismic and tsunami hazard assessments by systematically quantifying epistemic uncertainties in ground-motion simulations derived from kinematic rupture models. Using the 2015 Mw 8.3 Illapel earthquake in Chile as a test case, the authors evaluate the impact of kinematic rupture parameters (rupture velocity, rise-time, hypocenter location) and 1D velocity models on simulated ground motions at eight stations. They find that adopting depth-dependent rupture velocities (0.3 Vs in the shallow domain <10 km, and 0.5 Vs at depths >15 km) significantly reduces bias and root mean square error. Rupture velocity is identified as the primary parameter controlling ground-motion variability, with regional velocity models providing a better fit to observations in the 0.5–3 Hz frequency band. This work establishes a physically consistent source representation for future integrated seismic-tsunami hazard assessments.

sum: This paper presents a novel prestack migration method for visco-acoustic VTI media by integrating the De Wolf renormalization scattering series approximation. To overcome the limitations of the classical Born approximation under strong forward accumulative effects, the authors renormalize the Born series and establish its integral representation for visco-acoustic VTI media. Using a thin-slab approximation, they divide the velocity model into background and perturbation parameters, constructing dual-domain (frequency-wavenumber and frequency-space) screen migration operators. Tests on the synthetic Overthrust and Hess models demonstrate that the proposed operator effectively compensates for amplitude attenuation and corrects anisotropic effects, yielding migration images with higher signal-to-noise ratio and resolution compared to conventional methods.

sum: This study measures the sound velocities of CaSiO3 davemaoite up to 80 GPa and 973 K using Brillouin spectroscopy and resistively heated diamond anvil cells. The results show that the tetragonal-cubic phase transition occurs below 900 K throughout the lower mantle. Crucially, cubic davemaoite exhibits significantly reduced shear-wave velocities under deep lower-mantle conditions. Because of these low velocities, a pyrolitic lower mantle containing davemaoite cannot match seismic observations, even with increased bridgmanite. The authors propose that davemaoite is depleted in the ambient lower mantle but concentrated in Large Low-Shear-Velocity Provinces (LLSVPs), likely originating from late-stage crystallization during magma-ocean differentiation. This provides a mineral physics explanation for seismic anomalies in the deep Earth.

sum: This dataset contains a high-resolution relocated seismicity catalog of 25,227 earthquakes in the Christiana-Santorini-Kolumbo (CSK) volcanic region of the Aegean Sea, spanning January 2024 to April 2025. Accompanying a Science Advances publication, the catalog was constructed using waveform cross-correlation to achieve precise hypocentral locations. The spatial-temporal evolution of these events reveals a cascading sequence of magmatic unrest and aseismic faulting facilitated by elastic stress transfer. This dataset provides critical observational constraints on the interaction between magmatic systems and tectonic faults in active volcanic arcs.

sum: This study addresses how trench-parallel strain is partitioned between megathrust slip and upper-plate deformation in oblique subduction zones. By analyzing global slab geometry, plate motions, and earthquake focal mechanisms, the authors show that megathrust earthquakes slip less obliquely than plate convergence but rarely normal to the trench. To explain this, they develop a work-minimization model of strain partitioning that predicts dip-dependent limits on megathrust slip obliquity and preferred slip directions. This framework offers a mechanical basis for estimating strain accumulation on megathrusts, with significant implications for seismic-cycle and terrane-translation models.

sum: This study investigates the recycling of radiogenic osmium via crustal foundering in subduction zones using pyroxenite xenoliths from the northern Andean arc. By analyzing Re-Os and oxygen isotopic compositions of crust- and mantle-derived pyroxenites, the authors provide geochemical evidence for the downward transport of radiogenic crustal material into the mantle wedge. The findings highlight the role of gravitational instability (foundering/delamination) of lower arc crust in modifying the chemical and isotopic signature of the sub-arc mantle, offering key insights into mass transfer and crust-mantle interactions in convergent margins.

sum: This study generalizes the source correlation function in seismic interferometry to incorporate finite temporal and spatial correlations. Analytically evaluating their effects on cross-correlation waveforms, the authors show that finite temporal correlation induces frequency-dependent phase shifts and amplitude modifications. Notably, a parallel time shift (PTS) occurs at low frequencies, shifting both positive- and negative-lag waveforms in the same direction. Conversely, finite spatial correlation does not cause phase delays but attenuates and alters the amplitude structure. These findings provide a theoretical framework for interpreting seismic interferometry measurements under realistic, correlated noise source conditions.
本研究将地震干涉中的震源相关函数推广到有限时空相关性。解析评估表明，有限时间相关性会引起频变相位偏移和振幅修改，尤其在低频处产生使正负延迟波形同向移动的平行时间偏移（PTS）。相反，有限空间相关性不产生相位延迟，主要衰减并改变振幅结构。该成果为实际噪声源条件下的干涉测量提供了理论基础。

t: Analytical generalization of the seismic interferometry source correlation function to incorporate finite temporal and spatial correlations, evaluating their mathematical effects on cross-correlation waveforms.

sum: This paper presents a novel theoretical framework for elastic full-waveform inversion (FWI) in anisotropic media, formulated in the phase-space local-angle-domain (LAD). Instead of conventional acquisition-domain waveform misfit minimization, the method minimizes image-domain inconsistencies parameterized by position, propagation direction, scattering angle, azimuth, and time. By exploiting the separation of velocity and impedance perturbations in phase space, the author derives a generalized objective function, adjoint-state gradients, and Hessian operators. Under Born approximation, ray/beam formulations enable explicit Hessian computation. The near-orthogonality of directional and opening-angle sensitivities makes the Hessian diagonally dominant, which significantly reduces parameter crosstalk (e.g., velocity-reflectivity) and improves inversion stability. This framework unifies FWI, migration-velocity analysis, and impedance inversion, offering a robust solution to cycle-skipping and multi-parameter trade-offs in complex anisotropic elastic media.
提出一种相空间局部角度域各向异性弹性全波形反演理论框架。该方法最小化由位置、传播方向和散射角等参数化的图像域不一致性。通过推导广义目标函数、伴随梯度及Hessian算子，利用敏感度近正交性使Hessian呈对角主导，显著降低了速度与阻抗等参数间的串扰，并缓解周波跳跃，统一了弹性FWI与速度分析。

sum: This study investigates the deep thermal and dynamic state beneath the Cordilleran slab window in western Canada. Using teleseismic receiver functions and seismic tomography, the authors image the mantle transition zone (MTZ) discontinuities (410 and 660 km). They observe a localized thinning of the MTZ and associated low-velocity anomalies in the upper mantle. These observations provide strong seismic evidence for a lower-mantle heat supply, where hot material upwells from the lower mantle through the gap in the subducting slab (slab window). This process significantly influences the regional geothermal regime and lithospheric dynamics of the Canadian Cordillera.
本研究利用远震接收函数和层析成像，对加拿大西部科迪勒拉板块窗口下方的地幔过渡带（MTZ）进行了成像。结果显示，该区MTZ局部变薄并伴有上地幔低速异常。这提供了强有力的地震学证据，表明热物质通过俯冲板块缝隙从下地幔向上涌动，为该区提供了热供给，显著影响了区域地热与动力学特征。

sum: This study integrates petrological, geochemical, and geophysical datasets to characterize magmatic processes at Mt. Etna's South East Crater during 2022–2023. By combining olivine crystal chemistry (zoning and diffusion timescales) with bulk SO2 plume flux and volcanic tremor amplitude and location, the authors track magma migration and intrusion depths. They identify key phases of magma ascent, showing that the May 2022 effusive phase was driven by rapid migration of volatile-rich magma (Fo80 to Fo86) from ~9 km depth. This multidisciplinary approach demonstrates the power of linking petrological records of magma dynamics with real-time geophysical and geochemical monitoring signals to improve eruption forecasting and hazard assessment.
本研究整合了岩石学、地球化学和地球物理数据，系统表征了埃特纳火山东南火山口在2022至2023年期间的岩浆活动过程。通过将橄榄石环带及扩散时标等岩石学约束，与二氧化硫羽流通量、火山微震振幅及震源位置等监测信号相结合，研究重建了岩浆运移与侵入深度。结果表明，2022年5月的喷发由深部（约9公里）富挥发……

sum: This Zenodo archive provides the complete set of model input files, geometry files, frictional parameters, and simulated event catalogues (including event time, magnitude, and location) required to reproduce the results of the study 'Single Fault Earthquake Cycle Complexity' by Sun and Becker (2026). This dataset enables researchers to explore the frictional and geometric controls on earthquake cycle complexity and recurrence statistics.

sum: This study investigates temporal changes in the Earth's outer core P-wave velocity from 1977 to 1995. Using short-period PKP waves generated by French Polynesia underground nuclear tests and recorded at station BRVK in Kazakhstan, the author identifies a non-ray-theory first-arriving phase, termed PKrKP, as an internal reflection from the outer core using finite-frequency sensitivity analysis. By measuring PKrKP-PP and PKiKP-PP double differential travel times, a least-squares inversion reveals that outer core P-wave travel times fluctuated over time: being 0.1–0.15 s faster during 1982–1983 and 1988–1990, and 0.15–0.2 s slower in 1995. This provides key evidence for temporal dynamics within the Earth's outer core.
本研究利用地下核试验PKP波研究1977-1995年外核P波速度变化。通过有限频分析识别出外核内部反射新震相PKrKP。利用双差走时反演，发现外核P波走时存在显著波动：在1982-1983和1988-1990年偏快0.1-0.15秒，1995年偏慢0.15-0.2秒。这为外核动态演化提供了关键证据。

t: Finite-frequency sensitivity analysis to identify the PKrKP phase, followed by double-differential travel-time measurements (PKrKP-PP and PKiKP-PP) and least-squares inversion.

sum: This paper presents an inverse physics-informed neural network (PINN) framework to reconstruct the space-time history of mantle thermal convection. Reconstructing mantle dynamics is challenging due to sparse, noisy observations. To address this, the author develops a PINN that assimilates irregular near-surface kinematics from tracer trajectories alongside a terminal interior temperature structure (representing present-day seismic imaging). Through twin experiments, the method successfully reconstructs transient temperature and flow fields under noisy conditions. The study demonstrates that combining both surface kinematics and terminal interior constraints is essential to avoid nonunique or physically distorted histories, highlighting the potential of PINNs for integrating heterogeneous geophysical data into geodynamic reconstructions.
本文提出了一种逆物理信息神经网络（PINN）框架，用于重建地幔热对流的时空演化历史。针对地质观测稀疏且多噪的问题，该方法通过双胞胎实验，将示踪剂轨迹提取的非规则近地表运动学特征与终态内部温度结构（模拟现今地震成像）进行同化。结果表明，该方法在噪声干扰下仍能准确重建瞬态温度和流动场。单一约束会导致非唯……

sum: This study evaluates the real-time performance of the ShakeAlert earthquake early warning system during the 5 December 2024 Mw 7.0 Offshore Cape Mendocino earthquake. Using real-time seismic (EPIC, FinDer) and geodetic (GFAST-PGD) algorithms, the system generated its first solution 15 seconds post-origin. Although an early spurious trigger fortuitously aided location accuracy, the offshore epicenter and sparse station coverage limited initial magnitude estimates. FinDer provided rupture geometry estimates, while GFAST-PGD functioned as expected but did not trigger alerts. Network latency remained under 2 seconds, enabling the delivery of approximately five million alerts with warning times of 5–55 seconds for areas experiencing strong shaking (intensity 6+). The event highlights the need for improved offshore location algorithms, server-side solution integration, and robust handling of spurious triggers.

sum: This paper introduces the Delaunay-Based Adaptive Technique for Earthquake Station Selection (DATES) to improve the Propagation of Local Undamped Motion (PLUM) method for earthquake early warning (EEW). While PLUM is robust because it avoids source parameter estimation, its reliance on a fixed selection radius makes it sensitive to uneven station distributions. DATES addresses this by using Delaunay triangulation to adaptively select reference stations based on local density and azimuthal coverage. Tested on strong-motion data from the 2023 Mw 7.8 Türkiye–Syria earthquake using 232 highly inhomogeneous stations, DATES achieved full station coverage with a shorter selection radius. It extended the average warning lead time from 10.5 s to 12.2 s without increasing prediction errors, suppressing overestimation in dense networks and expanding warning times in sparse regions.

sum: This study investigates the seismic properties of mature coastal and developing inland sabkhas along the Arabian Gulf to improve static corrections in seismic reflection processing. Using high-resolution seismic surveys with 10 cm geophone spacing alongside conventional 2 m spacing surveys, the authors characterize the shallow velocity structure, particularly the partially saturated zone and hardground layer. The results show that high-resolution surveys successfully delineate these shallow boundaries, whereas conventional, replacement, and tomographic approaches fail to provide reliable static corrections in mature coastal sabkhas due to high geological complexity. The study highlights the necessity of ultra-high-resolution near-surface seismic surveys for accurate imaging in sabkha environments overlying hydrocarbon reservoirs.

sum: MUONITH v1.0 is a high-speed simulation platform designed to optimize multi-directional muography observation configurations for targets like volcanoes. It features a fast flux model based on a continuous slowing down approximation (CSDA) and a 2D lookup table, combined with C++20, Digital Differential Analyzer ray tracing, and OpenMP/OpenBLAS acceleration. The tool provides a single-direction resolution metric and performs 3D density reconstruction via regularized linear inversion with maximum a posteriori (MAP) estimation. MUONITH achieves a two-to-three-order-of-magnitude speed-up compared to previous GNU Octave implementations, reducing computation times from tens of hours to minutes on a consumer laptop. This enables researchers to rapidly evaluate observation designs and narrow down parameters before running expensive Monte Carlo simulations.

sum: This study demonstrates a novel, scalable approach for imaging permafrost structures in remote Arctic regions using Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS). By deploying a 2 km fiber-optic array near Utqiagvik, Alaska, the authors passively recorded naturally occurring cryoseismic events generated by shallow thermal contraction cracking. They extracted surface-wave dispersion characteristics from these cryoseismic signals, evaluating the effects of gauge length and wave-propagation direction. Subsequent shear-wave velocity (Vs) inversions successfully revealed deep ice-rich layers, interpreted as massive ground ice. This work highlights the potential of utilizing cryoseismic energy recorded on DAS for cost-effective, high-resolution, and long-term time-lapse monitoring of permafrost dynamics, which is critical for understanding Arctic hydrology and supporting infrastructure resilience under climate warming.

sum: This paper introduces a Hybrid Quantum AlexNet architecture designed for global-scale, cross-sensor recognition of volcanic thermal activity using spaceborne imagery. To address the computational, storage, and generalization challenges of classical deep learning in Earth Observation, the model integrates a classical convolutional backbone for spatial feature extraction with a parameterized quantum circuit (PQC) variational layer. By mapping high-level features into a high-dimensional Hilbert space, the quantum layer enhances feature discrimination and transferability across heterogeneous sensors and volcanic environments. Experimental results demonstrate that this hybrid quantum model achieves superior cross-sensor robustness and classification performance while requiring fewer trainable parameters and less training data than its fully classical counterpart, making it highly suitable for resource-constrained on-board processing applications.

sum: This study investigates fluid pressure changes in fault zones during the seismic cycle using triaxial rock friction experiments on water-saturated Westerly granite. By monitoring in-situ pore pressure during quasi-static loading and dynamic slip, the authors identify a poroelastic pore pressure increase during locked loading (fault closure) and a systematic drop during dynamic slip (poroelastic opening). Deviations occur as inelastic dilation in small events and potential compaction or thermal pressurization in large events. Crucially, prior to macroscopic slip, a pore pressure drop of up to 1 MPa is detected, correlated with inhomogeneous preslip and inelastic dilation during nucleation (1-10 µm slip). A stability analysis shows that poroelastic coupling stabilizes faults by compensating normal stress variations under undrained conditions. This work clarifies the transition from inelastic dilation during nucleation to poroelastic dominance during dynamic rupture.

sum: This study presents an integrated high-density 2-D seismic acquisition, processing, and interpretation workflow to characterize the Yahu deep brine system in the Qaidam Basin. By utilizing forward modeling to optimize acquisition geometry, the authors significantly improved the signal-to-noise ratio and reflector continuity. Horizon calibration identified four major seismic markers (T1, T2', T2, T3) corresponding to key formations. Velocity analysis and migration revealed a complex shallow domain controlled by a detachment fault overlying a coherent deep anticline. The results demonstrate that the Yahu area is a vertically inherited faulted anticline system, providing a high-resolution structural framework for evaluating deep brine preservation and resource potential.

sum: This paper presents a novel generative AI architecture based on the Conformer model to bridge the gap between low-frequency physics-based simulations and high-frequency strong ground motion requirements (0-20 Hz). Building on the SeismoALICE framework, the authors integrate Encoder, Decoder, and Discriminators with Conformer attention mechanisms under the Adversarial Learning Inference with Conditional Entropy (ALICE) framework. They introduce Hyper-Spherical Loss (HSL) in the time domain and Focal Frequency Loss (FFL) for time series. Trained on the STEAD dataset, the model outperforms previous approaches in earthquake data super-resolution. Its application to the 2019 Mw 4.9 Le Teil earthquake at the Cruas Nuclear Power Plant demonstrates its capability to enhance strong motion synthesis for engineering applications.

sum: This study presents a high-resolution Pn velocity and anisotropy model of the uppermost mantle beneath the Eastern Mediterranean and Anatolian region using a nonuniform grid tomography method. By adapting grid spacing to regional ray density, the method resolves fine-scale lateral heterogeneities and complex anisotropy patterns. The results provide new insights into the lithospheric deformation, mantle flow, and geodynamic processes associated with the subduction systems and continental collision in the region.

sum: This study presents a high-resolution 3D S-wave velocity model of the crust and uppermost mantle (down to 60 km) across the Zagros-Makran transition in southeastern Iran using ambient noise full-waveform inversion. The model reveals pronounced structural segmentation: low-angle (8°-10°) oceanic subduction in Makran, crustal thickening (up to 55 km Moho) beneath the Urumieh Dokhtar Magmatic Arc, and thick sedimentary packages. A mid-crustal high-velocity anomaly beneath the southern UDMA indicates solidified magmatic rocks, while another beneath the Jaz Murian basin represents remnant oceanic lithosphere. The results show depth-dependent segmentation across the transition zone, refining our understanding of the Arabia-Iran convergent margin.

sum: This study applies a novel constraint to spacecraft tracking data to directly estimate Mars' crustal density across its hemispherical dichotomy. The authors determine a northern crustal density of 2622 ± 42 kg/m³ and a southern crustal density of 2492 ± 36 kg/m³. These estimates are independent of seismic data but highly consistent with InSight seismic constraints, which limit the north-south density difference to under 200 kg/m³. Even when accounting for high-density volcanic provinces, the density difference remains within these seismic bounds. This work provides crucial, independent constraints for future crustal thickness modeling and helps elucidate the geodynamical origin of Mars' hemispherical dichotomy.

sum: This paper presents LitCurate, an open-source, configuration-driven, AI-assisted framework designed to construct structured scientific databases from literature. Utilizing large language models (LLMs) within an auditable, stage-wise workflow, LitCurate integrates literature discovery, relevance screening, full-text processing, and structured information extraction while preserving provenance. To demonstrate its utility, the authors apply LitCurate to compile an equation-of-state (EoS) database for lower-mantle high-pressure mineral phases. The resulting database contains 1,334 entries extracted from 205 experimental and theoretical papers, linking EoS parameters to mineral phases, compositions, formulations, and methods. This framework offers a reusable, transparent approach to transforming unstructured scientific literature into machine-readable datasets for geophysics and computational mineral physics.

sum: This paper addresses the challenge of optimizing surface sensor arrays for microseismic moment tensor inversion, which is critical for reducing inversion errors. By deriving the analytical gradient of the dynamic response matrix's condition number using singular value perturbation theory, the authors introduce three gradient-based optimization strategies: BP (BFGS with quadratic penalty), FMC/SQP (sequential quadratic programming), and CB (center-boundary parameterization). Tested across five region shapes and complex constraints, these methods significantly reduce the condition number and improve optimization robustness compared to gradient-free baselines. Synthetic experiments demonstrate that minimizing the condition number leads to a 50-fold reduction in source mechanism inversion errors, offering a highly efficient toolchain for practical seismic network design.

sum: This Zenodo repository provides the dataset and source code associated with the study of a unified quadratic scaling relation between earthquake potency and local magnitudes (ML) spanning from -1.8 to 7.5. The work addresses the long-standing challenge of reconciling scaling behaviors across vastly different earthquake sizes, from microearthquakes to major events. By establishing a quadratic relation, the authors offer a more robust framework for magnitude-potency conversion, which is critical for seismic hazard assessment, catalog unification, and understanding earthquake physics.

sum: This paper revisits the hydromechanical formulation of micromechanics-based phase-field models for fracture in poro-elastoplastic media. The authors identify that common choices—specifically, non-associative flow rules and Helmholtz free energy formulations using fluid pressure instead of fluid content—cause discontinuous strength surfaces across the tension-compression transition and omit critical coupling terms. To resolve this, they propose incorporating an associative Drucker-Prager flow rule and the omitted coupling term, ensuring a continuous strength surface and accurate fracture driving forces. The model's accuracy is validated against the analytical Kristianovich-Geertsma-de Klerk (KGD) hydraulic fracturing benchmark. Numerical simulations demonstrate its capability to reproduce both shear-dominated fractures from mechanical disturbances and tension-dominated fractures from fluid injection in saturated porous media.
本文重新评估了孔隙弹塑性介质裂缝的流固耦合相场模型。作者指出，传统非关联流动法则及以流体压力为自变量的自由能会导致拉压过渡区强度面不连续。为此，本文引入关联德鲁克-普拉格流动法则和缺失的耦合项，确保了连续强度面和准确的裂缝驱动力。该模型通过KGD水力压裂基准验证，能有效重现剪切和拉伸主导的裂缝。

sum: This paper introduces EKI-MultiCMT, a novel framework for Multiple Centroid Moment Tensor (Multi-CMT) inversion of complex earthquakes using Ensemble Kalman Inversion (EKI). Multi-CMT inversion is typically highly nonlinear and computationally expensive. By employing EKI, a derivative-free, ensemble-based optimization method, the framework updates all subevent parameters collectively. It incorporates physical priors (Tikhonov regularization, aftershock kernel-density estimates) and waveform measurements (cross-correlation similarity and lag-time). A randomize-then-optimize strategy provides uncertainty quantification. Validated on synthetic cases and applied to the 2016 Kaikoura and 2024 Noto Peninsula earthquakes, EKI-MultiCMT reduces the required forward simulations by two to three orders of magnitude compared to Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) methods, enabling routine, flexible, and computationally efficient multi-segment rupture characterization.

sum: This paper extends the theoretical framework for elongated earthquake ruptures to incorporate unpinned rupture widths, along-dip stress and strength heterogeneities, and non-linear slip-weakening (e.g., thermal pressurization). The authors validate their theoretical developments using dynamic rupture simulations. They propose a computationally efficient two-step procedure to estimate maximum earthquake rupture sizes: first, determining rupture widths using 2D fracture mechanics on vertical sections, and second, constraining rupture lengths via the equation of motion for elongated ruptures. By analyzing seismologically-inferred slip models of global earthquakes, they identify scaling relations for fracture energy and energy release rate, offering a physics-based tool for seismic hazard assessment of both natural and induced earthquakes.
本文扩展了窄长地震破裂理论，考虑了可变宽度、应力与强度非均匀性及非线性滑移弱化。作者利用动力学破裂模拟验证了该理论，并提出一种预测地震破裂尺寸的高效两步法：先用二维断裂力学确定各剖面破裂宽度，再用运动方程约束破裂长度。通过分析全球地震滑移模型，他们建立了断裂能标度关系，为天然和诱发地震的物理危害性评……

sum: This study utilizes time-variable gravity field data from Mars orbiters (MGS, ODY, MRO) to perform tidal tomography of Mars. The authors find that degree-3 components of the time-variable gravity field deviate by up to 300% from spherically symmetric models. This discrepancy is explained by a >20% lateral variation in the mantle's effective shear modulus, which correlates with the Martian crustal dichotomy. The results infer a persistent 200–400 °C thermal anomaly in the mantle beneath the southern highlands, potentially caused by regional mantle convection or crustal insulation over billions of years.
本研究利用火星轨道器时变重力场数据进行潮汐断层成像。发现重力场3阶分量与球对称模型偏差达300%，表明地幔有效剪切模量存在>20%的横向变化，且与地壳二分性高度吻合。由此推断火星南部高地下方地幔中保留有200-400 °C的热异常，可能由区域地幔对流或南部厚地壳的长期保温作用所致。

sum: This study evaluates four modeling approaches for upper-plate surface deformation driven by subduction zone megathrust earthquakes, focusing on the South American plate. Using an 8000 km-wide finite-element mesh, the authors compare elastic and viscoelastic models (Maxwell and Burgers rheologies) under different slip histories. They find that while near-trench deformation is similar across models, inland deformation (>200 km) varies significantly. A purely elastic model underestimates continental-interior velocities. Only a Burgers rheology with a realistic cyclic slip history successfully reproduces decadal-to-centennial observations, such as the persistent trenchward deformation 50 years after the 1960 Valdivia earthquake. The study constrains the Kelvin-Voigt shear modulus to be 4 to 15 times smaller than the elastic shear modulus, demonstrating that asthenospheric effective viscosity increases from annual to decadal timescales and highlighting the necessity of accounting for millennium-scale strain accumulation.
本研究利用有限元模拟评估了四种俯冲带震间形变模型。对比弹性与粘弹性（Maxwell和Burgers）流变学发现，弹性模型低估了南美内陆形变。仅有Burgers流变学结合周期性地震循环模型能解释跨越数十至数百年的大陆尺度观测（如1960年Valdivia地震后的持续形变）。研究表明软流圈有效粘度随时间……

sum: This study constructs a 3D shear-wave velocity (Vsv) model of the Fennoscandian lithosphere by jointly inverting Rayleigh wave phase velocities and S-to-P receiver functions. The joint inversion resolves absolute velocities and strong vertical gradients, placing the highest velocities (>4.7 km/s) at depths of 140–210 km. By comparing these seismic observations with thermodynamic predictions based on depleted peridotite compositions, the authors show that deep high velocities (>150 km) are consistent with a cold geotherm and a minor diamond fraction (~0.5 vol.%). Conversely, slower-than-expected velocities in the shallow lithosphere are attributed to radial anisotropy and metasomatic minerals (carbonates/hydrous phases). This work provides a detailed thermal and compositional characterization of cratonic lithospheric layering.

在解释观测到的速度梯度时，径向各向异性、成分和温度之间存在潜在的折衷。
Combining joint seismic inversion with thermodynamic modeling of depleted peridotites, including diamond fraction and metasomatic mineral effects, to explain cratonic layering.

Thermodynamic modeling of shear-wave velocities based on depleted peridotite compositions.
Correction for anelasticity and radial anisotropy in velocity predictions.

基于亏损橄榄岩成分的剪切波速度热力学建模。

S-to-P receiver functions.
