sum: This study evaluates ground-motion models (GMMs) that incorporate rupture heterogeneity via coseismic slip distributions and interseismic coupling, comparing them to traditional minimum-distance (R_RUP) models. Using 19 interface events (Mw > 6.7) and ~1400 records from the NGA-Subduction database, the authors developed slip-informed GMMs using mean distance metrics (R_P). Residual analyses show that slip-informed GMMs systematically reduce interevent variability (tau) by up to 30% globally, and up to 50% for megathrust events (Mw > 8.1) at short spectral periods (T <= 1.0 s). Pre-event interseismic locking models also show remarkable consistency with coseismic slip-informed predictions. Although physically informed approaches introduce epistemic uncertainty from source model variability, they significantly enhance the physical realism of subduction-zone GMMs for seismic hazard assessment.
本研究评估了引入破裂非均匀性（通过同震滑动分布和震间耦合）的地面运动模型（GMM），并与传统最小距离模型进行对比。利用NGA-Subduction数据库中19个俯冲带界面地震（Mw>6.7）及约1400条强震记录，构建了基于平均距离指标的滑动感知GMM。残差分析表明，该模型使全球层面的事件间变率降低……

t: Formulation of ground-motion models incorporating rupture heterogeneity through mean distance metrics derived from coseismic slip and interseismic coupling.
利用同震滑动和震间耦合计算的平均距离指标，构建考虑破裂非均匀性的地面运动模型。
Dataset of 19 subduction interface earthquakes (Mw > 6.7) and approximately 1400 ground-motion records from the NGA-Subduction database.
采用NGA-Subduction数据库中19个俯冲带界面地震及约1400条地面运动记录。
Slip-informed GMMs reduce interevent standard deviation by up to 30% globally, and up to 50% for megathrust events at short-spectral periods.
滑动感知模型使全球事件间标准差降低达30%，特大地震短周期降低达50%。
Physically informed approaches introduce additional epistemic uncertainty due to source model parameter variability.
由于震源模型参数的变率，物理信息方法会引入额外的认知不确定性。
Incorporating spatial slip heterogeneity and pre-event interseismic locking directly into subduction-zone GMM distance metrics.
将空间滑动非均匀性和震前震间锁合直接引入俯冲带GMM的距离指标中。

kc: Developed slip-informed ground-motion models (GMMs) for subduction zones using mean distance metrics (R_P) to account for rupture heterogeneity.
Demonstrated a global reduction of up to 30% in interevent standard deviation (tau), and up to 50% for megathrust events (Mw > 8.1) at short spectral periods.
Validated the use of pre-event interseismic locking models as effective forward-modeling tools for ground-motion prediction.
利用平均距离指标（R_P）构建了考虑破裂非均匀性的俯冲带滑动感知地面运动模型（GMM）。
证明了该模型可使全球事件间标准差（tau）降低达30%，在短周期和特大地震（Mw > 8.1）中降低达50%。
验证了利用震前震间锁合模型作为地面运动预测前瞻性建模工具的有效性。
me: Formulation of alternative GMMs using mean distance metrics (R_P) derived from coseismic slip distributions.
Residual analysis to evaluate interevent and intra-event variability compared to traditional R_RUP-based models.
Forward modeling using pre-event interseismic locking/coupling distributions.
利用基于同震滑动分布计算的平均距离指标（R_P）构建新型GMM。
进行残差分析，以评估其与传统基于R_RUP模型相比的事件间和事件内变率。
利用震前震间锁合/耦合分布进行前瞻性数值模拟。
de: Selected 19 subduction interface earthquakes (Mw > 6.7) with available coseismic slip models from the NGA-Subduction database.
Analyzed approximately 1400 ground-motion records associated with these events.
从NGA-Subduction数据库中筛选了19个具有同震滑动模型的俯冲带界面地震（Mw > 6.7）。
分析了与这些事件相关的约1400条地面运动记录。

tm.why: The paper evaluates and develops ground-motion models (GMMs) for seismic hazard analysis in subduction zones.
The GMMs incorporate rupture heterogeneity through coseismic slip distributions and interseismic coupling.

sum: This study evaluates how source and basin characteristics influence ground motions and bias historical earthquake magnitude estimates derived from macroseismic intensity distributions in continental foreland basins. Using seismic wavefield simulations with varying magnitudes, thrust fault locations, and basin structures, the authors combine simulated ground motions with peak ground velocity-intensity-magnitude relationships. They find that fault proximity to the foreland basin and earthquake magnitude are the primary controls on ground motions. Moving a fault ~50 km from the range front reduces ground motions equivalent to a 1–2 Mw decrease. Basin structure further amplifies peak ground accelerations by 1.5–2 times near the margin. Neglecting these factors can bias historical magnitude estimates by up to 0.5 Mw, with total uncertainties reaching ~1 Mw, significantly impacting seismic hazard assessments in collision zones.
本研究通过波场模拟评估了前陆盆地中震源与盆地特征对地面运动及历史震级估算的影响。断层距山前距离和震级是主控因素，断层远离50km相当于震级降低1-2 Mw。盆地结构使边缘附近加速度放大1.5-2倍。忽略盆地效应会导致历史震级估算偏差达0.5 Mw（总不确定性达1 Mw），对地震危险性评估有重要意义。

t: Seismic wavefield simulations combined with empirical peak ground velocity-intensity-magnitude relationships to model ground motions across varying thrust fault locations and basin structures.
结合经验烈度关系的地震波场模拟，用于计算不同断层位置和盆地结构下的地面运动。
Synthetic ground-motion data generated from wavefield simulations of thrust earthquakes in a continental foreland basin setting.
通过数值模拟生成的大陆前陆盆地背景下逆冲地震合成地面运动数据。
Fault distance from the range front (~50 km) alters ground motions by 1–2 Mw equivalents; basin structures amplify PGA by 1.5–2x, causing up to 0.5 Mw magnitude misestimation.
断层距山前距离改变地面运动相当于1-2 Mw；盆地结构使PGA放大1.5-2倍。
Relies on synthetic wavefield modeling and empirical intensity relations, which simplify real-world 3D structural complexities and building vulnerability variations.
依赖于合成波场模拟和经验烈度关系，简化了实际复杂的三维地质结构。
Quantifies the systematic trade-offs and biases (up to 1 Mw total uncertainty) in historical earthquake magnitude estimation specifically within continental foreland basin settings.
定量评估了大陆前陆盆地中，历史地震震级估算因盆地和断层位置产生的系统偏差。

kc: Quantified the systematic biases in historical earthquake magnitude estimates (up to 0.5 Mw individually, and ~1 Mw total uncertainty) caused by neglecting basin structures and fault locations.
Demonstrated that fault proximity to the range front is a dominant control, where a ~50 km shift corresponds to a 1–2 Mw ground-motion difference.
Showed that basin structure amplifies peak ground accelerations by a factor of 1.5–2 near the basin margin.
定量评估了因忽略盆地结构和断层位置导致的历史地震震级估算系统偏差（单项偏差达0.5 Mw，总不确定性约1 Mw）。
证明了断层与山前的距离是主控因素，~50公里的位移相当于1-2个Mw单位的地面运动差异。

Integration of simulated ground motions with empirical peak ground velocity (PGV)–intensity–magnitude relationships.
改变地震震级、逆冲断层位置和盆地结构进行地震波场模拟。
将模拟的地面运动与经验峰值地面速度（PGV）-烈度-震级关系相结合。

通过模拟大陆前陆盆地背景下逆冲地震产生的合成地面运动数据。

The study utilizes seismic wavefield simulations with varying earthquake magnitudes, thrust fault locations, and basin structures to model ground motions.

sum: This study quantitatively calibrates microwave-frequency fiber interferometry (MFFI) against collocated distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) using a 15.3 km terrestrial-submarine cable on Kefalonia Island, Greece. The authors derive and experimentally verify a conversion model showing that MFFI signals approximate the spatial mean of collocated DAS signals. They demonstrate MFFI's sensitivity across three regimes: ocean waves (0.1-0.4 Hz), earthquakes (1-12 Hz, detecting events down to ML 1.7), and localized traffic. While MFFI cannot spatially separate signals due to environmental noise superposition along the fiber, it successfully recovers broadband seismic phase and amplitude information, establishing it as a cost-effective, long-range alternative to DAS.
本研究利用希腊15.3 km光缆，将微波光纤干涉（MFFI）与共轴DAS定量校准。结果表明MFFI信号近似为共轴DAS信号的空间平均。MFFI在海浪、地震（可测ML 1.7事件）和交通频段具有高敏感性。尽管MFFI无法空间定位，但能有效恢复宽频带地震相位与振幅，是高性价比的长距离应变测量手段。

t: Derivation of a conversion model approximating integrated microwave-frequency fiber interferometry (MFFI) signals as the spatial mean of collocated distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) signals.
推导转换模型，将集成的微波光纤干涉（MFFI）信号近似为共轴DAS信号的空间平均。
Two months of continuous data from a 15.3 km terrestrial-submarine telecommunication cable on Kefalonia Island, Greece, simultaneously instrumented with MFFI and DAS in 2024.
希腊15.3 km陆地-海底光缆上同时部署MFFI与DAS获取的两个月连续数据。
MFFI successfully resolved ocean waves (0.1-0.4 Hz), earthquakes down to ML 1.7 at ~13 km distance, and localized traffic, recovering phase and amplitude consistent with the spatial DAS mean.
MFFI成功记录海浪、地震（低至ML 1.7）及交通信号，恢复的相位与DAS空间平均一致。
Inability to spatially separate superposed environmental background noise (roadside traffic and ocean waves) along the entire cable length due to the integrated nature of MFFI.
由于集成测量特性，无法在空间上分离沿整条光缆叠加的环境背景噪声（交通和海浪）。
First quantitative calibration of MFFI against collocated DAS, establishing a verified conversion model and characterizing MFFI's broadband sensitivity across multiple frequency-source regimes.
首次将MFFI与共轴DAS定量校准，建立并验证转换模型，系统表征其宽频带敏感性。

kc: Derived and experimentally verified a conversion model showing MFFI signals approximate the spatial mean of collocated DAS signals.
Demonstrated MFFI sensitivity to ocean waves (0.1-0.4 Hz), local earthquakes (1-12 Hz, down to ML 1.7), and localized traffic.
Established MFFI as a cost-effective broadband strainmeter capable of long-range deployments beyond the ~100 km limit of DAS.
推导并实验验证了转换模型，证明MFFI信号近似于共轴DAS信号的空间平均。
展示了MFFI对海浪（0.1-0.4 Hz）、地方震（1-12 Hz，低至ML 1.7）和局部交通信号的敏感性。
确立了MFFI作为一种高性价比宽频带应变仪的地位，可用于超出DAS（~100 km）限制的超长距离部署。
me: Microwave-frequency fiber interferometry (MFFI) for integrated strain measurement.
Distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) for collocated high-resolution spatial strain measurement.
Mathematical derivation of a conversion model relating integrated MFFI phase changes to spatial averages of DAS strain.
用于集成应变测量的微波光纤干涉技术（MFFI）。
用于共轴高分辨率空间应变测量的分布式声学传感（DAS）技术。
建立将集成MFFI相位变化与DAS应变空间平均联系起来的转换模型数学推导。
de: A two-month (2024) field experiment using a 15.3 km terrestrial-submarine telecommunication cable on Kefalonia Island, Greece, instrumented with both MFFI and DAS.
2024年在希腊凯法利尼亚岛进行为期两个月的野外实验，使用同时装备了MFFI and DAS的15.3公里陆地-海底通信光缆。
li: MFFI integrates signals along the entire fiber, leading to spatial superposition of environmental noise (traffic, ocean waves) that cannot be spatially separated like in DAS.

The study evaluates a new fiber-optic instrumentation technique (MFFI) using a terrestrial-submarine cable to record earthquakes, ocean waves, and traffic.

sum: This paper evaluates the altitude-dependent attenuation and morphological degradation of thermoremanent magnetic anomalies in UAV-borne surveys. Using a synthetic model of a magnetized kiln and upward continuation of fluxgate data from an iron-production site in Norway, the authors show that a buried magnetized cylinder retains only 11% of its near-surface peak amplitude at 2 m sensor height, and 3% at 4 m. The study demonstrates that while UAV magnetometry is effective for site detection, sub-metre sensor heights are crucial for resolving detailed intra-site morphology.
本文评估了无人机磁法勘探中热剩磁异常随高度增加的衰减与形态退化。通过对磁化窑炉进行合成建模，并对挪威某炼铁遗址的磁力仪数据进行向上延拓，研究表明埋深0.3米的磁化圆柱体在2米传感器高度处仅保留11%的近地表峰值振幅，在4米处仅剩3%。研究指出，尽管无人机磁测适用于遗址普查，但要解析精细的内部结构，仍……

t: Synthetic forward modeling of a magnetized cylinder combined with upward continuation of field fluxgate magnetometer data.
结合磁化圆柱体合成正演模拟与野外磁通门磁力仪数据的向上延拓。
Synthetic kiln model and field fluxgate magnetometer data from the Storbekken 1 iron-production site in Norway.
合成窑炉模型以及来自挪威Storbekken 1炼铁遗址的实测磁通门磁力仪数据。
Peak magnetic anomaly amplitude drops to 11% at 2 m and 3% at 4 m sensor height for a buried kiln.
对于埋藏窑炉，磁异常峰值振幅在2米传感器高度处降至11%，在4米处降至3%。
Relies on upward continuation and synthetic modeling rather than direct multi-altitude UAV flight measurements.
依赖于向上延拓和合成建模，缺乏直接的多高度无人机实测飞行数据。
Quantifies the altitude-dependent loss of signal and spatial resolution specifically for thermoremanent archaeological targets.
专门针对热剩磁考古目标，量化了随高度变化的信号损失与空间分辨率退化。

Demonstrated that peak magnetic anomaly amplitudes drop to ~11% at 2 m and ~3% at 4 m sensor heights for a typical buried kiln model.
Provided practical guidance on sensor height trade-offs between regional site detection and detailed intra-site morphological mapping.

为区域遗址普查与精细内部形态制图之间的传感器高度权衡提供了实用指导。

Upward continuation of measured fluxgate magnetometer data from the Storbekken 1 iron-production site in Norway.
对代表考古窑炉的均匀磁化圆柱体进行合成正演模拟。
对挪威Storbekken 1炼铁遗址实测的磁力仪数据进行向上延拓。

Field fluxgate magnetometer data from the Storbekken 1 iron-production site in central Norway.
直径2米、厚1米、埋深0.3米的磁化圆柱体合成模型。

sum: This study utilizes infrasound observations from the OSIRIS-REx Sample Return Capsule reentry on September 24, 2023, to calibrate the cylindrical blast wave theory normalization constant k. By inverting observed periods from 39 stations (altitudes 44-62 km) using a weak-shock propagation model, the author obtains period-inverted blast radii without pre-defining k. Combining these with aerodynamic drag energy yields a median k = 0.396, supporting Sakurai and Jones/Plooster formulations over Few (1969). The study also reveals significant along-trajectory variation in k, indicating it is an ensemble-effective rather than station-invariant constant. A rapid period-based estimator for blast radius is proposed.
本研究利用2023年9月24日OSIRIS-REx样品返回舱重返大气层时的红外声波观测数据，校准了柱状冲击波理论中的归一化常数k。通过弱冲击传播模型反演39个台站观测到的周期，获得了爆炸半径。结合气动阻力能量，得到中值k=0.396，支持了Sakurai和Jones/Plooster公式。研究表明k……

t: Inversion of observed infrasound periods using a weak-shock propagation model to determine blast-wave radius without pre-defining the normalization constant.
利用弱冲击传播模型反演观测到的红外声波周期，在不预设归一化常数的情况下确定爆炸半径。
Infrasound periods observed at 39 stations from the OSIRIS-REx Sample Return Capsule reentry spanning altitudes of 44-62 km.
OSIRIS-REx样品返回舱重返大气层期间，39个台站在44-62公里高度观测到的红外声波周期。
A median normalization constant k of 0.396 was determined, and a rapid period-based blast-radius estimator R_0 = 23.99 tau - 0.73 was established.
确定了中值归一化常数k为0.396，并建立了快速的周期-爆炸半径估计公式。
The calibrated relations are derived from a single non-ablating event and require validation across multiple events.
校准关系基于单一非烧蚀事件，需要多事件验证。
First inverse calibration of the blast-wave normalization constant using real hypersonic reentry infrasound without prescribing the constant beforehand.
首次利用真实高超音速重返红外声波数据，在不预设常数的情况下反演校准了爆炸波归一化常数。

kc: Inverted observed infrasound periods from the OSIRIS-REx reentry to determine the blast-wave normalization constant k without prior assumptions.
Determined a median k = 0.396, validating Sakurai (1965) and Jones (1968) models while showing that k varies along the trajectory.
Proposed a highly accurate, altitude-independent period-based relation for rapid blast-radius estimation.
反演了OSIRIS-REx重返大气层的红外声波周期，在无先验假设下确定了冲击波归一化常数k。

me: Weak-shock propagation modeling to invert observed infrasound periods.
Modified-bootstrap resampling to estimate confidence intervals for the normalization constant.
Regression analysis to establish a period-to-blast-radius scaling relation.

sum: This study presents an updated crustal shear-wave velocity model of the Pamir region using adjoint-state surface-wave traveltime tomography. Rayleigh-wave dispersion data were compiled from teleseismic and regional earthquakes, alongside ambient noise processed via three-station interferometry to handle asynchronous records. The resulting model reveals prominent middle-to-lower crustal low-velocity zones (LVZs) spatially aligned with major active faults bounding micro-blocks. Although estimated melt fractions within these LVZs are below the threshold for large-scale channel flow, they significantly reduce rock strength. This melt-induced weakening focuses deep-seated strain and promotes fault development, thereby regulating the modern crustal kinematics of the Pamir. The novelty lies in using three-station interferometry for asynchronous data and demonstrating that sub-threshold melt fractions can still control regional kinematics through localized weakening rather than large-scale flow.
本研究利用伴随状态面波成像构建了帕米尔地壳速度模型，整合了地震及三台站干涉处理的非同步背景噪声。结果显示，中下地壳低速带与活动断裂空间重合。虽然熔体比例低于通道流阈值，但足以显著降低岩石强度，使深部应变集中并促进断裂发育，调控现代地壳运动。该研究阐明了低比例熔体通过局部弱化控制区域动力学的机制。

sum: This study addresses the challenge of unstable low-frequency (<0.1 Hz) ocean-bottom noise in passive seismic imaging by proposing an earthquake coda-wave horizontal-to-vertical spectral ratio (HVSRC) approach. Using OBS data offshore Fukushima, the authors demonstrate that HVSRC provides stable measurements in the 0.05–10 Hz range. By inverting the averaged HVSRC curves using the diffuse field assumption and the 'hvgeneralized' algorithm, they construct high-resolution 1D shear-wave velocity models down to ~10 km depth. The resulting models align with existing geological constraints and successfully resolve a low-velocity zone associated with the subducting plate interface at ~7 km depth, demonstrating the efficacy of HVSRC for deep marine subsurface characterization.

sum: This study addresses the challenge of generalizing deep learning models for classifying local earthquakes and explosions across different geographic regions. By combining seismic scalograms (wavelet-based time-frequency representations) with phase detection probabilities, the proposed method enhances feature representation and model robustness. The accompanying dataset published on Zenodo contains preprocessed seismic waveform data, metadata, and signal attributes (such as SNRs and P/S ratios) from 16 distinct localities (e.g., ALCUDIA, TIBET, MSH), providing a comprehensive benchmark for training and evaluating generalized machine learning classifiers in seismology.

sum: This paper introduces ETAS+, a novel method that extends the positive statistics framework to the Epidemic-Type Aftershock Sequence (ETAS) model. By focusing on complete magnitude-time intervals defined by pairs of earthquakes where the second event is larger than the first, ETAS+ overcomes the bias introduced by short-term fluctuations in catalog completeness. Synthetic tests demonstrate that ETAS+ retrieves nearly unbiased parameter estimates from highly incomplete catalogs, whereas classical approaches fail. When applied to Southern California, the productivity scaling parameter α approaches the b-value, supporting self-similar earthquake triggering. ETAS+ offers a robust, computationally efficient tool for seismicity analysis and earthquake forecasting.

sum: This study addresses the challenge of spatially inconsistent separation of dynamic and fault-slip-induced components in regional near-fault ground motions. The authors propose a unified frequency-based framework that determines a single optimal cutoff frequency (0.29 Hz) using a global objective function across all spatial locations. This method consistently separates acceleration-dominated dynamic motions from displacement-dominated fault-slip-induced deformations. Analysis of the decomposed components reveals that dynamic components control acceleration-related responses, while fault-slip-induced components dominate permanent displacement and long-period spectral behavior. Furthermore, directional spectral analysis shows that the influence of fault slip is highly direction-dependent, being significantly stronger in the fault-parallel direction than in the fault-normal direction.

sum: This study investigates the impact of 3D fault geometry complexities on slip behavior using quasi-dynamic simulations of two parallel faults with uniform rate-weakening friction, accelerated by hierarchical matrices. The authors identify four distinct slip regimes—periodic earthquakes, coexisting slow slip events (SSEs) and earthquakes, only SSEs, and complex sequences—controlled by the strength of fault interactions. They quantify this interaction using a geometry-dependent metric based on the maximum Coulomb stress induced by a unit stress drop on a neighboring fault. While a single planar fault produces only earthquakes, geometric complexity and the resulting traction heterogeneity are shown to be sufficient to generate both slow and fast earthquakes, reproducing observed moment-duration scaling.

sum: The paper presents the Bay Assessment Model (BAM), an open-source, Python-based hydrologic model designed to simulate salinity and water levels across 54 basins in Florida Bay. BAM computes interbasin fluxes using hydraulic gradients and is driven by rainfall, evapotranspiration, Everglades water levels, and tidal boundary conditions. Over a 1999-2026 validation period, the model shows low water level bias (-0.024 m) and zero mean salinity bias, though RMSE is 6.21 ppt. BAM serves as an efficient tool for evaluating the impacts of Everglades restoration scenarios.

sum: This study presents 367 new gravity stations in the Gubbio Quaternary basin, central Italy, increasing station density to 5 stations/km². By analyzing the residual Bouguer anomaly, the authors estimate the basin infill thickness (depth to bedrock). The results show an asymmetrical basin thickness, with a maximum depocenter of ~600 m in the geographic center, rapidly decreasing to ~150 m southward and ~350 m northward. This asymmetry challenges previous symmetric models and provides new constraints on the tectonic and sedimentary evolution of the Gubbio normal fault.

sum: This paper introduces DiffSWE2d, an open-source differentiable shallow water equations (SWE) solver implemented in PyTorch for end-to-end flood and tsunami modelling. Traditional SWE solvers are computationally expensive for inverse problems because gradients must be estimated through repeated forward simulations. DiffSWE2d addresses this by representing the time-marching physics as a differentiable computational graph, allowing automatic differentiation to propagate gradients directly through the solver. The author validates DiffSWE2d against two benchmark cases and demonstrates its utility in tsunami waveform inversion, showing its capability to infer model inputs via gradient-based optimization. This framework bridges physics-based hydrodynamic modelling with modern optimization and machine learning.
本文介绍DiffSWE2d，一个基于PyTorch的开源可微二维浅水方程求解器，用于端到端洪水和海啸建模。传统求解器在反演中估算梯度计算成本高。DiffSWE2d将物理过程表示为可微计算图，利用自动微分直接传播梯度。该求解器在两个基准案例上得到验证，并成功应用于海啸波形反演，展示了通过梯度优化推断模……

sum: This paper presents the comprehensive rebuild of the Alaska Earthquake Center's seismic acquisition, analysis, and product dissemination systems completed in late 2025. To address the challenges of monitoring a vast, tectonically diverse, and instrumentally heterogeneous region, the center implemented parallel on-premises and cloud-based deployments for high availability. The system utilizes detection and association pipelines optimized for both local and teleseismic scales, accommodating varying station densities. Additionally, a tiered catalog workflow automatically publishes high-quality real-time solutions while routing lower-quality events to analysts, successfully balancing rapid response times with long-term catalog precision.

sum: This study presents 2D P-wave velocity models of the northern Ecuadorian subduction zone using wide-angle seismic data from the HIPER2 experiment. Employing a Bayesian traveltime tomographic inversion, the authors map the forearc basement, characterized by a high vertical velocity gradient (>0.85 km/s/km). They identify two low-velocity zones: one in the inner margin wedge caused by fracturing/alteration, and another in the subducting oceanic crust (0.5–1.0 km/s reduction). The latter is interpreted as an unmapped fracture zone reactivated by plate bending near the Carnegie Ridge. This work provides key constraints on the structural heterogeneity and hydration of the subducting plate.
本研究利用HIPER2宽角地震数据，通过贝叶斯走时断层成像构建了厄瓜多尔北部俯冲带的二维P波速度模型。结合多道地震数据，确定了前弧基底位置（速度梯度>0.85 km/s/km），并发现两个低速带：一是内侧边缘楔内的裂隙蚀变带，二是俯冲洋壳中降低0.5-1.0 km/s的异常带（解释为受海脊弯曲激活的……

sum: This study presents a 2D multi-physics numerical modeling approach using the thermo-mechanical code JustRelax.jl to investigate central-vent caldera collapse. The models couple magma dynamics, tectonic stresses, and non-linear visco-elasto-viscoplastic rheologies. The authors identify two distinct ring fault development modes (outward-to-subvertical and radial) and show that the underpressure required for collapse scales logarithmically with the roof ratio. Thermal weakening significantly affects eruption potential, shifting the system from mass-injection-dominated to non-eruptive regimes.
本研究使用热力学代码 JustRelax.jl 建立了二维多物理场数值模型，探讨了中心通道破火山口塌陷的力学机制。模型耦合了岩浆动力学、远场构造应力和非线性粘-弹-塑性流变学。研究发现了两种不同的环形断层发育模式（向外至近垂直断层与径向断层），并指出塌陷所需的欠压与顶板比例呈对数比例关系。地壳热软化……

sum: This study utilizes the olivine forsterite composition of mantle residual peridotites to reconstruct Earth's thermal history. The results show a rapid decrease in olivine forsterite content from ~92.0 to 90.9 between 3.0 and 2.0 Ga, indicating a sharp drop in mantle potential temperature from ~1630 °C to ~1450 °C. Parameterized thermal evolution modeling demonstrates that this rapid cooling cannot be explained by gradual convective cooling under a stagnant lid. Instead, it requires a significant increase in heat loss efficiency, which the authors interpret as the transition from a stagnant or sluggish lid regime to a mobile-lid regime (modern-style plate tectonics). This provides direct petrological evidence for the onset of plate tectonics during the Neoarchean to Paleoproterozoic.
本研究利用地幔残留橄榄岩中的橄榄石镁橄榄石成分重建了地球内部的温度演化历史。结果显示，在3.0-2.0 Ga期间，橄榄石成分从~92.0快速降至90.9，对应地幔潜在温度从~1630 °C降至~1450 °C。参数化热演化模拟表明，这种快速冷却需要地幔热流失效率发生根本性转变，无法用单一滞留盖层模式……

sum: The authors develop a fully coupled structural and thermal evolution model for super-Earth exoplanets (1-10 Earth masses) within the PROTEUS framework. They find that in volatile-poor super-Earths, the silicate interior contracts by approximately 10% of its molten radius during cooling and crystallization, a process driven by the thinning silicate shell and largely independent of planet mass. Conversely, in volatile-rich super-Earths (at and above 5 Earth masses), thick outgassed atmospheres act as thermal blankets, throttling surface heat loss and maintaining a deep magma ocean, which limits contraction to about half of the volatile-poor value. This work highlights how mantle contraction and atmospheric coupling shape the transit radii of low-mass exoplanets.
本文在PROTEUS框架下开发了超级地球结构与热演化的全耦合模型。研究表明，在贫挥发分的1-10倍地球质量超级地球中，硅酸盐内部在冷却结晶过程中会收缩约10%，这由硅酸盐壳变薄驱动。相反，富挥发分的超级地球（≥5倍地球质量）因厚大气层阻碍表面散热而维持深层岩浆洋，使收缩量减半。该发现提示地幔收缩显著……

sum: This study investigates kilometer-scale, shallow, sediment-filled trenches on the Nullarbor Plain, Australia, to determine if they represent surface expressions of deep cave collapse. By integrating morphometrics, electrical resistivity tomography (ERT), passive seismic profiling, cave records, cliff exposures, and sedimentology, the authors demonstrate that these linear depressions are formed by vertically propagated collapse and sagging above deep cave conduits. The findings provide diagnostic criteria for identifying subdued karst collapse systems on Earth and serve as an analogue for interpreting similar linear depressions on other planetary surfaces.
本研究调查了澳大利亚纳拉伯平原上公里尺度的浅层沉积物填充沟槽，以确定它们是否代表深部洞穴塌陷的地表表现。通过整合形态计量学、高密度电法（ERT）、被动源地震剖面、洞穴记录、悬崖露头和沉积学，作者证明了这些线性洼地是由深部洞穴管道上方垂直传播的塌陷和下沉形成的。该研究结果为识别地球上不明显的岩溶塌陷系……

sum: This study addresses the challenge of locating acoustic emission (AE) events during laboratory rock deformation, where fracturing dynamically alters seismic velocity. The authors present a novel approach that integrates double-difference (DD) location with real-time velocity updates to account for progressive rock damage. Applying this method to sandstone samples under controlled stress conditions, they reconstruct the spatio-temporal evolution of AE events and validate the results using CT imaging of the main fracture. The dynamic velocity model prevents systematic location bias and accurately captures crack coalescence. This integrated framework bridging rock mechanics and seismology has significant implications for monitoring subsurface reservoirs, EGS, and CO2 storage.
本研究针对岩石破裂导致波速动态变化从而影响声发射（AE）定位的问题，提出了一种结合双差定位与实时速度更新的新方法。在砂岩样品变形实验中，该方法重建了AE事件的时空演化，并通过CT成像进行了验证。结果表明，引入动态速度模型可消除系统定位偏差，准确刻画裂缝合并过程。该方法为地下储层及地热监测提供了更可靠……

sum: This paper presents a machine learning-based approach to estimate the maximum magnitude of aftershocks following a major earthquake. Accurate forecasting of maximum aftershock magnitudes is crucial for seismic hazard assessment and post-disaster response. By leveraging statistical features of early aftershock sequences and mainshock parameters, the authors train machine learning models to predict the largest expected aftershock. The method improves upon traditional empirical relations (like Båth's law) by capturing complex non-linear relationships in seismic catalogs, providing a more reliable tool for real-time hazard mitigation.
本文提出了一种基于机器学习的方法来预测大震后的最大余震震级。准确预测最大余震震级对于地震灾害评估和灾后应急响应至关重要。作者利用早期余震序列的统计特征和主震参数，训练机器学习模型来预测预期的最大余震。该方法通过捕获地震目录中复杂的非线性关系，改进了传统的经验关系（如Båth定律），为实时防震减灾提供……

sum: This study investigates the 2012 Mw6.3 Palu, Indonesia, earthquake to refine the fault geometry of the Saluki segment of the Palu-Koro fault system. By employing a Bayesian moment tensor inversion framework, the authors resolve the focal mechanism and associated uncertainties of the event. The updated fault geometry is then utilized to calculate Coulomb stress changes, providing critical insights into stress transfer, fault interactions, and seismic hazard in this highly active tectonic region. The work highlights the importance of probabilistic source characterization for accurate stress modeling.

sum: This paper applies the 'ecology of segregation' framework to Valdivia, Chile, to examine how historical colonization, the 1960 M9.5 earthquake, and neoliberal policies have shaped urban segregation and ecological disparities. It explores how social-ecological dynamics act as press and pulse disturbances, leading to the displacement of Indigenous Mapuche communities, post-earthquake urban sprawl, and wetland infill. The study highlights how wealthier neighborhoods gain better access to green spaces, and calls for inclusive, community-driven urban planning that incorporates Indigenous perspectives to address long-term environmental injustices in the Global South.

sum: This paper introduces the Seismic Processing Benchmark (SPBench), a standardized platform designed to address the lack of reproducibility and consistent evaluation in learning-based exploration seismic processing. SPBench covers six core tasks: random noise attenuation, trace interpolation, ground-roll suppression, multiple suppression, deblending, and first-arrival picking. The authors reproduce 24 supervised methods across 10 datasets under 43 standardized settings. To improve evaluation, they introduce signal-component-resolved evaluation (SCoRE) and a reference-free ridge-curvature score (RC_norm). Their analysis reveals that synthetic performance rankings do not reliably predict field performance, and rankings reorder significantly under coherent noise. SPBench provides a reproducible foundation for comparing seismic deep learning models.

sum: This study presents 3D coupled earthquake-atmosphere numerical simulations integrating dynamic rupture, seismic wave propagation, and a compressible nonlinear atmospheric model. The authors investigate how earthquake source parameters (magnitude, fault type, rupture speed, and heterogeneity) influence acoustic waves (AWs) at 100–300 km altitude. Key findings show that supershear ruptures produce earlier, distinct AW arrivals, while normal faulting generates weaker AWs than thrust faulting due to rarefaction waves. Tsunami earthquakes produce 20%–50% smaller AW amplitudes than standard thrust events of equivalent moment magnitude. Crucially, the study demonstrates that energy magnitude, rather than moment magnitude, primarily controls upper-atmospheric AW amplitudes, and nonlinear wave evolution complicates direct surface-to-atmosphere signal comparisons. These results highlight the potential of upper-atmosphere observations (e.g., GNSS) for constraining earthquake source characteristics.

sum: This paper systematically evaluates the performance of neural network priors (such as SIREN and generative-residual models) against traditional grid-based total-variation (TV) regularization in 2D acoustic full-waveform inversion (FWI). Using three synthetic targets (inclined layering, curved layering, and a high-contrast curved interface), the authors show that frequency continuation does not universally improve neural representations. While the generative-residual model improves velocity RMSE in some structures, Grid+TV performs better on curved layering and consistently yields superior predictions for unseen (held-out) shots. SIREN performs poorly across all targets. The study highlights that neural FWI performance is highly structure-dependent, and the authors advocate for joint reporting of model recovery, unseen-shot prediction, optimization cost, and negative outcomes.

sum: This paper introduces DiffClassNet, a novel deep learning framework based on denoising diffusion probabilistic models (DDPMs) for geophysical classification. By leveraging the multi-scale feature-learning properties of diffusion models, DiffClassNet extracts and aggregates features across multiple noise levels during the denoising process. This allows the model to learn hierarchical representations where different timesteps capture complementary signal characteristics, such as high-frequency onset patterns and broader energy distributions. The framework is evaluated on two seismic classification tasks in Texas: discriminating between natural earthquakes and quarry blasts, and identifying causal factors of induced seismicity (hydraulic fracturing vs. shallow/deep saltwater disposal) in the Delaware Basin. DiffClassNet achieves competitive performance compared to established baselines, demonstrating that diffusion-based learning offers a powerful and interpretable approach for seismic source classification.
本文提出基于去噪扩散模型的地球物理分类框架DiffClassNet。该方法在去噪中聚合多尺度特征，捕获从高频起震到宽频能量分布的互补信号。框架在德克萨斯州两个任务上进行了评估：区分天然地震与爆破，以及识别特拉华盆地诱发地震成因（压裂与废水回注）。结果表明，该模型分类性能优异且具可解释性，为地震分类提……

sum: This study analyzes local seismic shear-wave splitting parameters in the source region of the 2015 MW7.8 Gorkha, Nepal earthquake. The authors observe significant spatial variations in fast polarization directions from west to east, indicating upper crustal heterogeneity along the seismogenic fault strike, likely reflecting the tearing of the subducting Indian lithospheric plate. Additionally, large delay times decrease southward, indicating a southward-weakening stress accumulation. The delay times remained highly unstable for nearly a year after the mainshock, suggesting that seismogenic stress was not fully released by the mainshock and major aftershocks, leading to ongoing violent stress adjustments in the upper crust.

sum: This study analyzes a relocated machine learning-generated aftershock catalog of the 2017 Mw 8.2 Tehuantepec, Mexico earthquake, the largest recorded normal-faulting event in Mexico. Using data from temporary and permanent stations, the authors show that the rupture initiated 100 km offshore, ran northwest for 90 km, and then jumped 10 km inland across the trench-perpendicular Tehuantepec Ridge, continuing for another 60 km. Finite fault inversions support a two-plane normal fault model offset at the ridge. Moment tensor analysis reveals complex aftershocks before the ridge, whereas post-ridge aftershocks are exclusively thrust mechanisms, suggesting stress accommodation after normal-slip over-slip. A separate N-S trending divergent region at the rupture's end suggests a plate boundary between the Caribbean and North American plates.

sum: This paper evaluates whether filtering training data by signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) improves seismic deep learning. Testing on phase picking and ambient-noise dispersion, the authors find that SNR screening provides no consistent benefit for phase picking. For dispersion, while strict SNR filtering helps under specific training schedules, retaining a larger volume of unfiltered data (e.g., 29,788 vs 9,929 paths) reduces test error by 3.0% at the same compute budget. The study concludes that high SNR is not a reliable proxy for training data quality, and discarding weak signals often hurts performance by reducing dataset size.

sum: This paper presents a novel joint-constraint iterative framework for deblending simultaneous-source seismic data directly in the common-shot gather (CSG) domain. By combining the synchrosqueezed transform and the Radon transform, the method exploits differences in propagation directions of blended signals. First, the synchrosqueezed transform performs an initial separation to extract individual sources. Then, the Radon transform is applied to suppress residual blending interference without damaging signal amplitudes. Unlike conventional methods, this approach bypasses the need for time-delay coherence differences (time dithering), enabling real-time quality monitoring during acquisition. It is highly parallelizable and demonstrates high-fidelity separation on both synthetic and field datasets.

sum: This Zenodo dataset supports the development of near-complete 3D deformation mapping using Sentinel-1 extended burst overlap interferometry (EBOI). sum: This paper presents the operational dataset and infrastructure of the ICDP Eger project, which establishes a multi-parameter geodynamic laboratory in the West Bohemia/Vogtland region. The project aims to study earthquake swarms, crustal fluid flow, mantle degassing (CO2 and He), and the deep biosphere. The setup includes five boreholes (S1-S4, F3) equipped with high-frequency 3D seismic arrays, broadband seismometers, and real-time fluid monitoring systems. The dataset supports high-resolution, near-source observations of seismicity and fluid-fault interactions, as well as microbial and paleoclimate studies in maar structures.
本文介绍了ICDP Eger项目的运行数据集与基础设施。该项目在西波希米亚/福格特兰地球动力学区建立了深部多参数观测实验室，旨在研究地震群、地壳流体运移、幔源气体（CO2和He）释放及深部生物圈。观测系统由Nový Kostel地震活动区周边的5口钻孔（S1-S4, F3）组成，配备了高频三维地震台……

sum: This paper addresses the localization and clustering of retrogressive thaw slumps (RTSs) on the Tibetan Plateau under permafrost warming. The authors propose the Hillslope Weakening Field (HWF) framework, which integrates thermal, moisture, soil, topographic, permafrost, and land-cover conditions to represent relative hillslope weakening. Evaluating seven regions, they find strong HWF-RTS spatial correspondence in five, where RTSs preferentially occur on highly weakened, spatially continuous hillslopes. This explains the heterogeneous geomorphic response to uniform warming.
本文针对青藏高原多年冻土变暖背景下热融滑塌（RTS）的局部聚集性展开研究。作者提出了“山坡弱化场（HWF）”框架，综合考虑温度、水分、土壤、地形、冻土及地表覆盖等多种环境条件。通过对七个研究区域的评估，发现其中五个区域存在强烈的HWF-RTS空间对应关系，表明热融滑塌优先发生于高度弱化且空间连续的山……

t: The Hillslope Weakening Field (HWF) framework integrates thermal, moisture, soil, topographic, permafrost, and land-surface cover conditions to represent relative hillslope weakening states.
山坡弱化场（HWF）框架整合了温度、水分、土壤、地形、冻土和地表覆盖等条件以表征山坡弱化状态。
Spatial environmental datasets and retrogressive thaw slump (RTS) inventories across seven study regions on the Tibetan Plateau.

The study's predictive accuracy depends on the resolution and quality of regional environmental and permafrost datasets.

sum: This study uses finite-element numerical modeling to investigate how wedge subduction—the final stage of oceanic subduction—affects the dynamic modes of subsequent terrane-continent collision (TCC) versus continental-terrane subduction (CTS). Using the Paleo-Tethys Ocean closure as a natural laboratory, the authors systematically test the effects of initial wedge subduction angle, convergence rate, plate configuration, and continental terrane strength. They find that low subduction angles, fast convergence, and strong terranes promote TCC, whereas steep angles, slow convergence, and weak terranes favor CTS. These modeling results explain the observed east-west structural variations along the Paleo-Tethys suture zone, where the western/central segments likely underwent CTS and the eastern segment underwent TCC. This work provides a new geodynamic framework for understanding structural diversity in suture zones.
本研究利用有限元模拟探讨了楔形俯冲对地体-大陆碰撞（TCC）与大陆-地体俯冲（CTS）模式的影响。以古特提斯洋闭合为背景，发现低俯冲角、快速收敛和强地体有利于TCC模式，而陡俯冲角、慢速收敛和弱地体促进CTS模式。该结果解释了古特提斯缝合带东西段的结构差异，为理解全球缝合带多样性提供了新动力学视角。

t: 2D finite-element numerical modeling of lithospheric deformation to simulate the transition from oceanic wedge subduction to terrane-continent collision.
用于模拟从大洋楔形俯冲到地体-大陆碰撞转变的二维岩石圈变形有限元数值模拟。
Synthetic geodynamic model runs with varying physical parameters, qualitatively compared against geological and tomographic observations of the Paleo-Tethys suture zone.
改变物理参数的合成地球动力学模型运行，并与古特提斯缝合带的地质和断层成像观测进行定性对比。
Low wedge angles, fast convergence, and strong terranes favor terrane-continent collision (TCC), while steep angles, slow convergence, and weak terranes favor continental-terrane subduction (CTS).
低楔形角、快速收敛和强地体有利于地体-大陆碰撞（TCC），而陡角度、慢速收敛和弱地体则有利于大陆-地体俯冲（CTS）。
The 2D geometry simplifies complex 3D tectonic features such as oblique subduction and lateral slab tear during the Paleo-Tethys closure.
二维几何结构简化了复杂的三维构造特征，如古特提斯闭合期间的斜向俯冲和板块横向撕裂。
Systematically demonstrates the overlooked role of pre-collision wedge subduction geometry and dynamics in controlling the subsequent style of continental collision.

sum: This study proposes a novel mechanism for the origin of mid-mantle seismic discontinuities beneath subduction zones. By coupling thermo-mechanical subduction models with pressure-dependent fabric calculations of bridgmanite, the authors demonstrate that gradual slip transitions in bridgmanite with depth can produce anisotropic discontinuities near 1000 km. These strain-induced features are most pronounced in regions of strong slab-driven flow, yielding a ~1.5% shear-wave radial anisotropy contrast. Full waveform simulations confirm that these discontinuities are detectable using array seismological methods, linking mantle dynamics, mineral physics, and seismic observations.
本研究提出了一种解释俯冲带下方中地幔地震学不连续面成因的新机制。通过将热力学俯冲模型与桥石（bridgmanite）随压力变化的组构计算相结合，作者表明桥石随深度发生的渐进滑移转变可在1000公里附近产生各向异性不连续面。这种应变诱发的特征在强板块驱动流区域最明显，可产生约1.5%的剪切波径向各向异……

sum: This study identifies and characterizes 'repeated burst' (rb) sequences, a subtype of repeating earthquakes in North Chile. Unlike single-asperity repeaters, rb-sequences consist of short, dense event clusters that recur after long quiescent intervals. Using high-precision relative relocation, waveform similarity subclustering, and empirical moment-to-slip scaling, the authors analyze 19 rb-families (focusing on three in detail). They show that these sequences represent multi-asperity systems where closely spaced velocity-weakening patches fail in rapid succession. This behavior is driven by mechanical coupling via postseismic creep and elevated stressing rates within a creeping, velocity-strengthening fault zone. The study provides observational evidence of earthquake synchronization on small spatial and temporal scales, offering new insights into fault-zone properties and interaction.
本研究识别并表征了智利北部重复地震的一种新子类型——“重复爆发”（rb）序列。与单微凸体重复地震不同，rb序列表现为在较长静止期后发生的高密度短时群震。研究利用高精度相对重定位、波形相似性子聚类和经验矩-滑动标度关系，详细分析了19个rb家族中的3个。结果表明，rb序列反映了多微凸体系统，即在蠕变的……

t: High-precision relative relocation, waveform-similarity subclustering, and empirical moment-to-slip scaling to characterize repeating earthquake clusters.
利用高精度相对重定位、波形相似性子聚类和经验矩-滑动标度关系表征重复地震序列。
Seismic waveform data from North Chile, identifying 19 repeated burst families and analyzing three in extensive detail.
智利北部的地震波形数据，识别出19个重复爆发家族并对其中3个进行了详细分析。
Repeated burst sequences represent multi-asperity systems where closely spaced patches fail in rapid succession, driven by postseismic creep.

Defines and characterizes 'repeated burst' sequences as a signature of synchronized multi-asperity recurrence rather than single-asperity failure.
首次将“重复爆发”序列定义并表征为多微凸体同步复发而非单微凸体破裂的特征。

sum: This study evaluates Synthetic Template Matching (STM) for local seismic event detection in West Bohemia, Czechia. Unlike traditional matched-filter methods requiring prior real templates, STM generates synthetic templates across a grid of five fundamental focal mechanisms using a 1D velocity model. The performance is compared against the PEPiN detector-locator and an Artificial Neural Network (ANN). Applying STM to WEBNET data with a cross-correlation threshold of 0.4 detected 264 real local events, achieving a completeness magnitude of Mc=0.1. While STM does not outperform PEPiN or the ANN in detection sensitivity, it successfully and reliably estimates focal mechanisms and epicentral locations directly from the detection process, offering a robust alternative when prior waveform templates are unavailable.
本研究评估了合成模板匹配（STM）在捷克西波希米亚微震检测中的应用。该方法利用一维速度模型和五种基本震源机制生成合成模板，无需先验波形。在WEBNET数据中，STM检测到264个真实地震（Mc=0.1）。虽然检测灵敏度未超越神经网络，但STM能可靠估计震源机制和震中，为缺乏先验模板的地区提供了新方案……

t: Synthetic template matching using a 1D velocity model and a grid of five fundamental focal mechanisms to detect events without prior waveform templates.
利用一维速度模型和五种基本震源机制网格生成合成模板，进行无先验波形的匹配滤波检测。
Real seismic waveform data from the WEBNET network in the West Bohemia region, Czechia.

Eliminates the need for prior template waveforms by using synthetic templates generated from a 1D velocity model and fundamental focal mechanisms.

sum: This paper introduces a novel probabilistic framework for Probabilistic Fault Displacement Hazard Analysis (PFDHA) that moves beyond aggregate displacement metrics. Traditional models assume overlapping rupture strands contribute simultaneously to site demand, which is unrealistic for finite infrastructure footprints. Utilizing the Fault Displacement Hazard Initiative (FDHI) database of 75 surface-rupturing earthquakes, the authors reconstruct individual principal rupture strands. The framework models the number of overlapping ruptures, displacement partitioning, and spatial distribution relative to the primary fault trace. Integrated into a generalized PFDHA formulation, it accounts for magnitude, style of faulting, and location uncertainty. Benchmark applications demonstrate its capability to estimate intersection probabilities and displacement demands for specific structures, providing a physically consistent extension for engineering design.

sum: This paper presents a novel prestack diffraction separation workflow to isolate weak diffractions from strong reflections, facilitating high-resolution imaging of small-scale subsurface discontinuities like fractures and karst caves. The method first applies normal moveout (NMO) to enhance kinematic differences between diffracted and reflected waves. It then utilizes a quantum mechanical framework based on the Schrödinger equation to construct data-adaptive wave functions. Unlike fixed-basis transforms, these adaptive wave functions effectively capture the amplitude and frequency characteristics of both wave types. Reflections are reconstructed using their corresponding wave functions and subtracted from the shot gathers to isolate diffractions. Synthetic tests demonstrate successful detection of 5-m karst caves and faults, while application to the Nankai dataset confirms its capability to extract fracture-related diffractions under complex geological conditions.

sum: This paper presents a user-guided sequential parameter-estimation workflow to estimate anisotropic parameters in vertically transversely isotropic (VTI) media. Addressing the strong coupling between background velocity and anisotropic parameters in long-offset seismic data, the authors replace conventional low-order or fourth-order nonhyperbolic moveout approximations with a high-accuracy traveltime operator. This operator is integrated with a semi-automatic moveout-flattening and parameter-selection procedure. Using an objective-function-based grid search, the workflow estimates moveout parameters to recover Thomsen parameters eta and delta. Numerical tests on undulating layered models and applications to marine field reflection data demonstrate that this approach provides robust and efficient initial models for anisotropic seismic imaging and velocity model building.

sum: The authors model olivine crystal preferred orientation (CPO) and shear-wave splitting (SWS) in the mantle wedge of the NE Japan subduction zone using a 3-D thermomechanical model. The model predicts trench-normal (E-W) flow and fast axes beneath Tohoku, and more complex, depth-varying flow and fast axes beneath Hokkaido. While location-averaged model-predicted fast directions align well with observations (E-W in Tohoku, N-S in Hokkaido), the model systematically overestimates delay times. Furthermore, incorporating incidence angles and backazimuths does not resolve the discrepancy in individual event-station pair variability. These differences highlight the limitations of simplified mantle wedge models and suggest contributions from anisotropy outside the wedge or observational uncertainties.

sum: This study uses machine learning-accelerated path-integral simulations to calculate equilibrium hydrogen isotope fractionation between silicate melt and mantle minerals (bridgmanite, ringwoodite, wadsleyite) under magma ocean conditions. The results show that mineral-melt fractionation is too weak to produce the extremely low δD values observed in some ocean island basalts (OIBs) during magma ocean crystallization. Instead, these low δD signatures, combined with high 3He/4He ratios, are more plausibly explained by the selective transfer of primordial volatiles (water leakage) from Earth's core into the deep mantle. This provides strong evidence for sustained volatile exchange across the core-mantle boundary.

sum: This paper introduces Spec2VEC, an unsupervised and interpretable machine learning framework designed to extract robust features from non-stationary seismic and acoustic signals, particularly when labeled data is scarce. Spec2VEC processes spectrograms as structured, textured images through two pathways: a Textural path that maps 2D spectral patterns into 1D sequences using Hilbert space-filling curves for information-theoretic analysis, and a Spatial path (PDFSI) that separates coherent signals from stochastic noise. The framework is validated on synthetic wavefields, an Exotic Seismic Events Catalog (ESEC), and a Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) dataset. Spec2VEC achieves high-accuracy classification and anomalous arrival isolation without requiring massive training datasets, bridging classical signal processing and modern representation learning.

sum: This study uses numerical simulations to investigate how fault topography and roughness control rupture propagation, stress evolution, and microseismicity. By tracking micro-ruptures and stress states, the authors find that smoother faults maintain concentrated stress at fixed locations, facilitating extensive ruptures and large earthquakes. In contrast, rougher faults exhibit transient, discrete stress concentrations where micro-ruptures initiate but are quickly arrested by re-interlocking. This process leads to higher b-values and a self-locking-rupturing cycle of small, frequent microseismic events. The study establishes a direct mechanistic link between fault roughness and seismicity patterns.

sum: This study investigates the Kamchatka megathrust, focusing on how variable slip on persistent asperities influences seismic and tsunami hazards. By analyzing historical and modern megathrust earthquakes, the authors demonstrate that while asperities remain persistent features, their slip behavior varies across different earthquake cycles, significantly impacting tsunami generation and hazard assessment.

sum: This paper characterizes the petrology and geochemistry of the first 39 episodes (first year) of the 2024–ongoing episodic Halema‘uma‘u eruption at Kīlauea. Analyzing 178 samples (tephra, lava, and recycled ooze-out), the authors find no significant intra-episode geochemical variations, suggesting eruption dynamics are controlled by viscosity and conduit geometry. The study reveals a connection between active conduits and the still-molten 2020–2023 lava lake core. Geochemical enrichment in K2O and TiO2 indicates the arrival of a new magma composition. Melt and fluid inclusion barometry constrain magma storage to the shallow (1–2 km) Halema‘uma‘u reservoir. This work provides critical insights into post-2018 caldera collapse magmatic plumbing at Kīlauea.

sum: This study demonstrates that traffic-excited highway bridges act as persistent, spatially fixed seismic sources for time-lapse imaging of river corridors using Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) on roadside dark fiber. Evaluating the method during a record monsoon flood in South Korea (July 2025), the authors show that vehicle impacts excite 3-6 Hz flexural resonances of a 430 m bridge crossing the Miho River. These waves propagate over 400 m, imaging the alluvial section down to bedrock. Due to the stable source geometry, virtual source gathers converge within 5 minutes of stacking. Relative seismic velocity (dv/v) monitoring reveals velocity drops up to 1.0% during the flood, correlating with heavy precipitation and river stage rise. This highlights the potential of combining bridge vibrations and telecommunication fiber for continuous hydrogeophysical and structural health monitoring.
本文利用路侧暗光纤DAS，将车辆激发的桥梁振动作为持久地震源，对河流廊道进行延时成像。在2025年韩国洪水期间，车辆冲击激发桥梁3-6 Hz共振，传播超400米并对冲积层成像。由于源位置固定，虚拟源道集5分钟内即可收敛。监测发现洪水期间波速下降达1.0%，与降雨和水位上升引起的水文软化一致。

sum: This paper introduces CartoVec, a novel coordinate encoder that generates general-purpose location embeddings from geographic coordinates. Unlike image-grounded encoders, CartoVec is trained on structured open map data (Overture) to predict land cover, land use, transportation, and connectivity across multiple spatial scales. Evaluated on downstream tasks like Census outcomes, Airbnb prices, and crime rates, CartoVec's frozen embeddings outperform or match existing baselines. The model provides a practical coordinate-to-vector interface requiring no map lookup during inference.

sum: This paper addresses a fundamental limitation of using Generative Neural Networks (GNNs) for parameterizing geological priors in geophysical inversions: because Earth structure is not low-dimensional and GNNs have training errors, latent space inversions cannot reproduce the best higher-dimensional approximations of the true Earth. To overcome this, the authors introduce an 'escaping prior' distribution within a hierarchical Bayesian framework. This approach adaptively balances the GNN guide with the observed data, allowing the inversion to explore solutions beyond the GNN's generative manifold. Synthetic tomography tests demonstrate that the escaping prior outperforms standard latent space and model space inversions, successfully recovering solutions outside the GNN's range.

sum: This study analyzes tectonic low-frequency earthquakes (LFEs) in Shikoku, Japan, using a modified epidemic-type aftershock sequence (ETAS) model that incorporates a reference region to account for spatial interactions. The authors find that the background fraction (the ratio of background to total seismicity rate) is relatively high at both the shallower (up-dip) and deeper (down-dip) ends of the LFE source region, indicating a nonmonotonic depth dependency. At the down-dip end, triggering is suppressed by ductile deformation, whereas at the up-dip end, proximity to the locked megathrust zone inhibits stress propagation. These findings suggest that spatial variations in temperature-pressure conditions and frictional properties nonmonotonically influence LFE activity along the dip direction.

sum: This study investigates whether tectonic tremor accompanied slow-slip events (SSEs) in the Lower Cook Inlet (LCI) segment of the Alaska–Aleutian subduction zone from 2015 to 2017. Using continuous data from 34 broadband stations, the authors applied envelope cross-correlation and single-station frequency tracking. Neither method detected conclusive tectonic tremor. Synthetic simulations of tremor-like signals showed that while basin noise might obscure visual identification, cross-correlation methods should still have detected tremor if present. The absence of tremor in the LCI, contrasting with its presence in the Upper Cook Inlet, suggests that differences in subduction geometry, thermal state, or sediment load control tremor generation, demonstrating that coupled episodic tremor and slip is not globally ubiquitous.

sum: This study analyzes the tidal modulation of seismicity in the Ridgecrest, California area from 2008 to 2024, spanning the 2019 Mw 7.1 earthquake. Combining machine-learning-enhanced earthquake catalogs with a novel tidal modulation characterization method, the authors find that seismicity in the Ridgecrest fault zone shifted around 2014–2015 from a stress-controlled to a stress-rate-controlled regime. Additionally, the tidal modulation strength increased prior to the mainshock, a behavior not observed in the neighboring Coso volcanic field or Garlock fault. This shift is interpreted as a decrease in the fault's characteristic frictional time scale relative to the tidal period, indicating an increased loading rate and potentially reduced effective normal stress, representing a preparation phase before the major earthquake.

sum: This study revisits magnitude scaling relations for marsquakes and meteoroid impacts using InSight seismic data and post-InSight 1-D interior models. By performing waveform simulations, the authors quantify how velocity structure, attenuation, and source physics affect long-period magnitude scaling. They find that the shallow crustal structure beneath the InSight station primarily controls the scaling. The recalibrated marsquake magnitudes are, on average, 0.5 lower than the Marsquake Service (MQS) estimates. Additionally, introducing impact-specific scaling relations improves the agreement between seismic and crater-derived size estimates, enabling better matching of seismic detections to cataloged Martian impact craters.

sum: This study presents an automated workflow combining borehole and surface seismic data with deep-learning phase picking, automated association, and non-linear relocation to monitor seismic sequences in the Istanbul-Marmara region. Analyzing six ML 4.0–5.8 sequences from 2016 to 2023, the workflow detects eight times more events than conventional catalogs. Waveform cross-correlation and template matching reveal a strong increase in waveform similarity and spatial clustering prior to the 2016 ML 4.5 Çınarcık Basin event, and increased similarity before the 2019 ML 5.8 Silivri event. The study demonstrates that borehole arrays are critical for resolving these subtle pre-mainshock seismicity transients due to their high signal-to-noise ratios, providing a robust framework for near-real-time microseismic monitoring.

sum: This study addresses the challenge of forecasting volcanic eruption sizes, which is crucial for hazard assessment. While future eruption sizes are typically modeled using power-law distributions of past erupted volumes, real-world data often deviate from a pure power-law due to measurement uncertainties. The authors propose using an Exponentially Modified Gaussian (EMG) distribution to incorporate both the underlying power-law behavior and the observational uncertainties of past eruptions. They apply this statistical method to eruptive records from two high-risk calderas: Campi Flegrei in Italy and Taupo in New Zealand. The EMG distribution provides an excellent statistical fit to both datasets, demonstrating that the apparent deviations from power-law behavior can be explained by volume uncertainties, thereby validating the continued use of power-law frameworks for volcanic hazard forecasting.
本研究针对火山灾害评估中预测未来喷发规模的难题，提出了一种考虑历史喷发量测量不确定性的统计建模方法。虽然传统预测常假设喷发量服从幂律分布，但实际观测数据因不确定性常偏离幂律。研究引入指数修饰高斯（EMG）分布，将潜在的幂律特征与观测误差相结合。该方法被应用于意大利坎皮佛莱格瑞和新西兰陶波两个高风险破……

t: Fitting an Exponentially Modified Gaussian (EMG) distribution to model the combination of an underlying power-law eruption size distribution and log-normal observational uncertainties.
采用指数修饰高斯（EMG）分布，对潜在幂律喷发规模分布与对数正态观测不确定性的结合进行拟合。

The EMG distribution successfully fits the eruptive records of both calderas, confirming that observed deviations from power-laws are compatible with volume uncertainties.

sum: This study investigates why acoustic booms from the September 2026 Anak Krakatau eruption were heard in Bandung (240–300 km away) but not in Jakarta (150 km away). Using three lines of evidence—eruption timing from PVMBG and Darwin VAAC, atmospheric acoustic ray tracing (ERA5, HWM14, NRLMSIS), and Google search interest ("dentuman")—the author demonstrates that eastward stratopause winds created an acoustic duct focusing sound toward Bandung while leaving Jakarta in a shadow zone. A comparative analysis of the April 2020 eruption and a 2025 meteor validates this atmospheric propagation model and the use of search behavior as a proxy for acoustic audibility. The study highlights how seasonal stratospheric winds control long-range volcanic infrasound and audible sound propagation.
本研究探讨了2026年9月喀拉喀托火山喷发声音在万隆被听到而在雅加达听不到的原因。结合火山震颤、大气声波射线追踪及谷歌搜索趋势，研究表明平流层顶东风形成的声音通道将声波导向万隆，而雅加达处于声影区。对2020年喷发和2025年流星事件的对比验证了该模型，揭示了季节性平流层风对火山声波远距离传播的控制……

sum: This study presents cyclic loading experiments on polycrystalline MgO at lower mantle pressures and seismic frequencies (10–100 mHz) using a diamond anvil cell and a piezoelectric actuator. By analyzing time-resolved radial X-ray diffraction patterns, the authors extract lattice spacings to derive volume and differential lattice strains. At high strain amplitudes, phase shifts between differential lattice strains indicate significant energy dissipation via anisotropic plastic or anelastic deformation. At low amplitudes, the response is nearly elastic with minimal dissipation. This novel experimental approach enables the characterization of strain energy dissipation in mantle minerals under realistic seismic conditions, bridging the gap between high-frequency elasticity and static plastic deformation studies.

sum: This study presents a three-dimensional geometric model of the Gulang–Zhongwei fault zone in the northeastern Tibetan Plateau. By characterizing the spatial variation and structural complexity of the fault system, the authors provide critical constraints on fault segmentation and potential rupture areas. These geometric insights are essential for improving regional seismic hazard assessments and understanding the geodynamic evolution of the northeastern margin of the Tibetan Plateau.
本研究构建了青藏高原东北缘古浪—中卫断裂带的三维几何模型。通过刻画该断裂系统的空间变化与结构复杂性，作者为断裂分段和潜在破裂区域提供了关键约束。这些几何特征对于提高区域地震危险性评估水平以及理解青藏高原东北缘的动力学演化具有重要意义。

sum: This study performs hybrid broadband ground-motion simulations of multi-segment ruptures on the Alpine-Marlborough fault system in New Zealand. Utilizing rupture geometries from the 2022 National Seismic Hazard Model (Wairau, Clarence, and Hope faults) and a 3D crustal velocity model, the authors simulate kinematic ruptures propagating northward. The results demonstrate that Alpine-Marlborough ruptures generate strong northward directivity and basin response, leading to peak ground accelerations of ~0.1 g in Wellington. These amplitudes are comparable to those from the 2016 Kaikōura earthquake. The study highlights that these multi-segment ruptures have a collective likelihood similar to major local sources (Wellington Fault and Hikurangi subduction zone), representing a critical, previously underappreciated hazard for the upper South Island and lower North Island.
本研究对新西兰阿尔卑斯-马尔堡断裂系统的多段破裂进行混合宽频地震动模拟。利用最新破裂几何及三维速度模型，模拟了向北传播的运动学破裂。结果表明，破裂产生强烈的向北指向性和盆地效应，在惠灵顿产生约0.1g的峰值加速度，与2016年凯库拉地震相当。此类破裂概率与本地震源相当，构成重大灾害威胁。

结合多段运动学震源描述与三维地壳速度模型的混合宽频地震动模拟方法。

sum: This paper presents a comprehensive, open-access seismological dataset (network code ZK) collected during the DETECT experiment in the Southern Apennines, Italy. From August 2021 to August 2022, 20 dense seismic arrays comprising 200 stations (broadband, short-period, and geophones) were deployed across the active Irpinia fault system, which hosted the destructive 1980 M6.9 earthquake. The dataset totals approximately 5.2 TB of continuous waveforms managed via SeisComP and GEOFON. This high-density dataset provides unprecedented spatial resolution to study fault zone properties, microseismicity, and wave propagation in a high-hazard region.

sum: This paper presents a deep learning framework using two sequential fully convolutional neural networks (CNNs) to detect and classify unexploded ordnance (UXO) directly from multicomponent time-domain electromagnetic induction (EMI) data. By bypassing the traditional physics-based inversion step, the method significantly accelerates the classification workflow. The first CNN detects anomalies and characterizes spatially correlated noise from preprocessed field data, while the second performs multi-class classification using synthetic training data augmented with this noise. A physics-based parameterization of clutter is used to train the network to distinguish clutter from UXO. Validated on marine test datasets from Sequim Bay, the CNN successfully detected all UXOs and achieved false-positive rates comparable to physics-based inversion, demonstrating its potential as a rapid, automated first-pass classification tool.

sum: This study presents the first three-dimensional numerical models of peel-back delamination (PBD) on Venus to investigate rollback-style lithospheric recycling. By comparing model-derived trench geometries and flexural topography with observations from Artemis Corona, Atahensik Corona, and Derceto Plateau, the authors show that PBD initiation is facilitated by increased lithospheric thickness, which enhances negative buoyancy and drives crust-mantle decoupling. The evolution of trench geometry is controlled by rift geometry, lithospheric structure, and yield strength. Elastic thickness (Te) estimates from the southeastern trench of Artemis Corona suggest a thick thermal lithosphere of approximately 200–250 km (for a 1700 K mantle), providing crucial constraints on Venusian geodynamics and thermal state.
本研究首次建立了金星“剥离式”岩石圈拆沉（PBD）的三维数值模型，以探讨后撤式岩石圈循环机制。通过将模型预测的沟槽几何和挠曲地形与阿耳忒弥斯冕状物、阿塔亨西克冕状物和德耳塞托高原的观测数据进行对比，研究表明岩石圈厚度的增加促进了PBD的启动，增强了负浮力并驱动了壳幔解耦。沟槽几何的演化受裂谷几何、岩……

sum: This study investigates the Nelson Thrust Belt (NTB) in the northern South Island of New Zealand to understand how inherited Paleozoic to Eocene crustal structures control modern fault localization and reactivation. By integrating revised regional mapping, LiDAR imagery, trench and borehole observations, and reinterpreted vintage seismic reflection lines, the authors identify three principal fault groups (F1–F3) and a frontal splay (F4). They demonstrate that F2 and F3 are inverted normal faults, with inversion beginning in the Late Miocene. F1 is an out-of-sequence thrust truncating underlying structures. The results suggest a long-term break-back transfer of deformation, with Late Pleistocene–Holocene ruptures indicating overlapping earthquake cycles. This work highlights how inherited crustal heterogeneity distributes active deformation in contractional belts with limited modern subsurface imaging.
本研究聚焦于新西兰南岛北部的纳尔逊冲断带（NTB），探讨古生代至始新世继承性地壳结构如何控制现代断层的定位与活化。作者整合了区域地质填图、LiDAR图像、探槽与钻孔观测以及重新解释的复古反射地震剖面，识别出三个主要断裂组（F1-F3）和前缘分支（F4）。研究表明，F2和F3为反转正断层，反转始于晚中……

sum: This study derives analytical expressions for the stress intensity factor and static energy release rate of Mode II and III ruptures propagating through heterogeneous stress-drop distributions. The author demonstrates that rupture energetics, velocity, and arrest conditions are predominantly controlled by stress-drop heterogeneities with wavelengths comparable to the current rupture length. Shorter-wavelength heterogeneities are progressively averaged out, while longer-wavelength effects decay. This scale-dependent behavior explains why large-scale rupture processes remain reproducible in dynamic simulations despite unresolved small-scale heterogeneities. The findings suggest that observational constraints on fault structures at scales matching the rupture dimension are critical for forecasting large-earthquake scenarios.
本研究推导了II型和III型破裂在非均匀应力降分布中传播的应力强度因子和静态能量释放率的解析表达式。研究表明，破裂动力学、速度和终止条件主要受与当前破裂长度相当的应力降非均匀性波长控制。较短波长的非均匀性在能量积分中被逐渐平滑，而较长波长的影响则会衰减。这一尺度依赖特征解释了为什么在缺乏微观细节的情……

sum: This paper presents a spatial autocorrelation (SPAC) method to estimate Rayleigh-wave attenuation coefficients from passive microtremor array measurements. By formulating an attenuation-aware SPAC coefficient, the authors address the limitations of conventional phase-velocity-only methods. Theoretical analysis reveals that attenuation estimation is highly sensitive to directional aliasing, requiring denser azimuthal sampling, which is addressed using a regular heptagonal array. The method employs a two-stage fitting procedure: first-order approximation followed by complex SPAC coefficient fitting. Validated using synthetic data, P-SV wave propagation simulations, and field microtremor records, the proposed method successfully recovers attenuation coefficients. Compared to beamforming, it is less sensitive to wavefield directionality and performs better at longer wavelengths relative to array size, offering a robust tool for near-surface attenuation characterization.

sum: This study presents an improved baseline correction methodology that synchronously processes all three components of strong-motion recordings to preserve near-fault ground-motion characteristics, such as permanent tectonic displacements and velocity pulses. Applying this method to 59 recordings of the 2022 Guanshan foreshock and Chishang mainshock in Taiwan, the authors validate the results against nearby GNSS observations. The processed data reveal pronounced velocity pulses and permanent displacements, with peak-to-peak velocities concentrated along the rupture propagation direction. Additionally, a new classification framework distinguishes early-occurring fling-step pulses from temporally broader dynamic velocity pulses. The spatial distribution of these near-fault effects correlates well with documented bridge damage, providing a high-fidelity dataset for seismic hazard assessment and engineering applications.

sum: This study investigates the active tectonics of the Bodrum Peninsula in Western Anatolia and the seismicity following the 2017 Mw 6.6 Bodrum-Kos earthquake. By combining kinematic analysis of fault slip data with the spatial distribution of aftershocks, the authors define the structural characteristics and geometry of the newly proposed Bodrum Fault Zone. The results provide insights into the regional extensional stress regime and seismic hazard in the Aegean-Anatolian transition zone, highlighting the role of active normal and strike-slip faulting in accommodating crustal deformation.

sum: This paper addresses whether process-based hydrological models can match the accuracy of deep learning models at the catchment scale. The author introduces CaRT, a parsimonious model constrained by physical laws (conservation, dissipation, aggregation), and refines it into CaRT+ using AI-assisted hypothesis testing. CaRT+ incorporates 14 states and 35 parameters per catchment without daily neural networks. Evaluated on 602 British, 593 US, and 505 Australian catchments, CaRT+ achieves median Nash-Sutcliffe efficiencies (NSE) of 0.863, 0.765, and 0.778, respectively. These results match or exceed stateful and entity-aware LSTMs, demonstrating that physically-constrained, low-dimensional models can achieve deep-learning-level accuracy in rainfall-runoff modeling across diverse climates.

sum: This study investigates the deformation and reorientation of mafic microgranular enclaves during magma mingling using 96 two-dimensional Level-Set simulations. By modeling a dense, low-viscosity droplet in a lighter, highly viscous host under shear and gravity, the authors explore a wide range of viscosity ratios, capillary numbers, and Bond numbers. They identify sinking and non-sinking regimes spanning six distinct outcomes, including breakup, rotation, and retraction. The transition between these regimes is controlled by the ratio of capillary to Bond numbers. Crucially, the study demonstrates that because droplet breakup depends on accumulated deformation rather than simple capillary stability, the final enclave shape is a reflection of the overall flow regime rather than a direct measure of finite strain.

sum: This study analyzes the 2021 Mw 6.0 Yangbi earthquake sequence in China using high-precision hypocenter locations, focal mechanisms, tidal responses, and stress transfer. The results reveal complex seismogenic structures near a fault stepover, where foreshocks occurred on both main and conjugate faults. The temporal correlation between foreshock episodes, the mainshock, and peak dilational volumetric tidal strain suggests tidal triggering. The authors propose that the foreshock sequence was driven by deep overpressured fluids, transitional slow-slip events, and cascade triggering, with fluids acting as the primary driver. This suggests that tectonic complexity and fluid activity facilitate short-term foreshocks, offering insights into earthquake predictability.
本研究对2021年云南漾濞Mw 6.0地震序列进行了高精度定位、震源机制、潮汐响应及应力转移分析。结果表明，前震与断层阶区周围的主断层及共轭断层密切相关。前震序列及主震的发生时间与潮汐体应变峰值高度吻合，暗示了潮汐触发作用。研究指出，漾濞前震群是深部超压流体、过渡性慢滑移和级联触发共同作用的结果，其……

t: Comprehensive analysis of spatial-temporal earthquake distributions, tidal responses, focal mechanisms, rupture directions, and coseismic stress transfer.
综合分析时空地震分布、潮汐响应、震源机制、破裂方向及同震应力转移。
Seismic data from permanent and dense temporary networks monitoring the 2021 Mw 6.0 Yangbi earthquake sequence in China.
监测2021年中国漾濞Mw 6.0地震序列的固定和密集临时台网地震数据。
Foreshocks occurred near a fault stepover; three foreshock episodes and the mainshock coincided with peak dilational volumetric tidal strain, driven primarily by deep overpressured fluids.
前震发生于断层阶区附近；三次前震事件及主震与潮汐体应变峰值吻合，主要由深部超压流体驱动。
The involvement of deep overpressured fluids and slow-slip events is inferred indirectly from seismic observations rather than directly measured.
深部超压流体和慢滑移事件的参与是通过地震观测间接推断的，而非直接测量。
Links tectonic complexity (fault stepovers) and deep fluid activity to the generation of short-term foreshocks, proposing a mechanism for enhanced earthquake predictability.
将构造复杂性（断层阶区）和深部流体活动与短期前震的产生联系起来，提出了提高地震预测可能性的机制。

kc: Revealed complex, previously unknown seismogenic fault structures associated with the 2021 Yangbi sequence.
Demonstrated a strong temporal correlation between foreshock episodes/mainshock and peak dilational volumetric tidal strain.
Proposed a comprehensive model combining deep overpressured fluids, slow-slip events, and cascade triggering to explain the foreshock sequence.
揭示了与2021年漾濞地震序列相关的复杂且此前未知的发震断层结构。
展示了前震序列及主震与潮汐体应变峰值之间强烈的时空相关性。
提出了结合深部超压流体、慢滑移事件和级联触发的综合模型来解释前震序列。
me: Precise hypocenter determination using permanent and dense temporary seismic networks.
Analysis of focal mechanisms, rupture directions, and coseismic stress transfer.
Evaluation of tidal responses (dilational volumetric tidal strain).
利用固定和密集临时地震台网进行高精度震源位置测定。
分析震源机制解、破裂方向及同震应力转移。
评估潮汐响应（体应变潮汐）。
de: Seismic waveform data from permanent and dense temporary seismic networks monitoring the 2021 Mw 6.0 Yangbi earthquake sequence.
Tidal strain calculations and stress field data.
监测2021年Mw 6.0漾濞地震序列的固定和密集临时地震台网的波形数据。
潮汐应变计算及应力场数据。
li: The proposed role of deep fluids and slow-slip events is inferred indirectly rather than observed directly.
The findings are highly specific to the tectonic setting of the Yangbi sequence and may not apply universally to all strike-slip faults.
深部流体和慢滑移事件的作用主要是间接推断，而非直接观测。
研究结果高度依赖于漾濞序列的特定构造背景，可能不适用于所有走滑断层。

tm.why: The paper analyzes the rupture directions, coseismic stress transfer, and foreshock-mainshock-aftershock sequence of the Yangbi earthquake.
It investigates the role of fault stepovers, overpressured fluids, and slow-slip events in triggering foreshocks.
It utilizes detailed and precise hypocenter determinations to reveal complex seismogenic fault structures.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed abstract provided in the metadata, as no PDF was available.

sum: This document presents a correction to the previously published paper 'A new-generation multiparameter elastic model of the crust and upper mantle of the greater Alpine area and the Apennines using teleseismic full waveform inversion: data, method and models'. The original study developed a high-resolution multiparameter elastic model of the crust and upper mantle beneath the greater Alpine region and the Apennines using teleseismic full-waveform inversion (FWI). This correction addresses specific errors or omissions in the original publication to ensure the accuracy of the presented models.
本文是针对先前发表的利用远震全波形反演（FWI）构建大阿尔卑斯及亚平宁地区地壳与上地幔多参数弹性模型研究的勘误。原研究利用远震波形数据，通过多参数FWI方法获得了高分辨率的三维速度结构。本勘误旨在修正原论文中的特定错误或遗漏，确保该新一代区域弹性模型的准确性，为后续动力学研究提供可靠基础。

t: Teleseismic full-waveform inversion (FWI) was used in the original study to reconstruct multiparameter elastic models of the crust and upper mantle.
原研究采用远震全波形反演方法重建地壳和上地幔的多参数弹性模型。
Teleseismic earthquake waveforms recorded across the greater Alpine area and the Apennines.
记录于大阿尔卑斯地区和亚平宁山脉的远震地震波形数据。
The correction ensures the accuracy of the presented multiparameter elastic model of the Alpine crust and upper mantle.
该勘误确保了所提出的阿尔卑斯地壳和上地幔多参数弹性模型的准确性。
The document is a correction and does not introduce new methods or datasets beyond the original scope.
本文为勘误性质，未引入原研究范围之外的新方法或数据集。
Corrects the published record for the new-generation multiparameter elastic model of the Alpine region.
修正了关于阿尔卑斯地区新一代多参数弹性模型的已发表学术记录。

kc: Corrects errors or omissions in the original publication regarding the multiparameter elastic model of the Alpine region.
修正了原关于阿尔卑斯地区多参数弹性模型研究论文中的错误或遗漏。
me: Teleseismic full-waveform inversion (FWI) (from the original paper).
远震全波形反演 (FWI)（源自原论文）。
de: Teleseismic earthquake waveforms (from the original paper).
远震地震波形数据（源自原论文）。
