作为勘误，它仅修正了原论文中的特定错误，未提出新的科学发现。

tm.why: The original paper corrected by this erratum uses teleseismic full waveform inversion.
The target of the original study is the crust and upper mantle of the Alpine area.
The study constructs a 3D multiparameter elastic velocity model.

ev.notes: Analyzed based on the title and metadata of the correction and the original paper.

sum: This study addresses the surface expression of slab tearing and trench retreat in southern Italy by dating high-elevation marine terraces (100–1,000 masl) in southern Calabria using luminescence methods. The results yield a weighted mean burial age of 118.8 ± 8.7 ka across all elevations, indicating these terraces represent a single, deformed, once-continuous erosional surface. The calculated extremely rapid uplift rates (up to 12 mm/yr) and high normal fault throw rates (0.8–4.2 mm/yr) suggest that post-120 ka deformation is an ongoing isostatic response to an active tear in the subducting Ionian slab. This rapid transient uplift aligns with geodynamic models and geophysical observations, providing critical constraints on regional geohazards and seismic risk in one of the Mediterranean's most active tectonic zones.
本研究利用光释光测年方法对意大利南部卡拉布里亚海拔100至1000米的海成阶地砂层进行了定年。结果显示，不同高度阶地的埋藏年龄重合，加权平均年龄为118.8 ± 8.7 ka，表明它们属于同一个被变形和断裂分割的连续侵蚀面。计算得出该区抬升速率高达12 mm/yr，活动正断层垂直位移速率达0.8-4……

t: Luminescence dating of shallow marine sands combined with regional geomorphic mapping and fault-zone morphology analysis.
浅海相砂层的光释光测年，结合区域地貌制图和断裂带形态分析。
Shallow marine sand samples from terraces at elevations of ~100 to 1,000 masl in southern Calabria, Italy.
采集自意大利南部卡拉布里亚海拔约100至1000米海成阶地的浅海砂样。
A single deformed terrace surface dated to 118.8 ± 8.7 ka, indicating rapid uplift rates up to 12 mm/yr and fault throw rates of 0.8–4.2 mm/yr.
阶地加权平均年龄为118.8 ± 8.7 ka，表明抬升速率达12 mm/yr，断层位移速率为0.8-4.2 mm/yr…
Potential uncertainties in correlating highly fragmented erosional terrace remnants across a wide elevation range (100–1,000 masl).
在宽海拔范围内对比高度破碎的侵蚀阶地残余存在空间不确定性。
First reliable ages for high-elevation (>200 masl) marine terraces in southern Calabria, linking rapid transient uplift to active slab tearing.
首次获得卡拉布里亚高海拔阶地的可靠年龄，将快速瞬态抬升与活动板块撕裂直接联系。

kc: Determined the first reliable luminescence ages (weighted mean of 118.8 ± 8.7 ka) for high-elevation marine terraces (up to 1,000 masl) in southern Calabria.
Demonstrated that these disparate terraces represent a single, once-continuous deformed erosional surface.
Quantified exceptionally high uplift rates (up to 12 mm/yr) and normal fault throw rates (0.8–4.2 mm/yr) in southern Italy.
Linked rapid surface uplift directly to the geodynamic process of active slab tearing in the Ionian subduction zone.
首次对意大利南部卡拉布里亚高海拔（达1000米）的海成阶地进行了可靠的光释光测年，获得118.8 ± 8.7 ka的加权平均年龄。
证实了这些高度不同的阶地原本属于同一个连续但后期发生变形的侵蚀面。
定量计算出该地区极高的抬升速率（达12 mm/yr）和正断层垂直位移速率（0.8-4.2 mm/yr）。
将地表快速抬升与伊奥尼亚俯冲带活动板块撕裂这一深部地球动力学过程直接联系起来。
me: Luminescence dating (optically stimulated luminescence / infrared stimulated luminescence) of shallow marine sands.
Regional geomorphic and surface mapping to correlate marine terrace remnants.
Structural analysis of fault-zone morphology to calculate fault throw rates.
对浅海相砂层进行光释光（OSL/IRSL）测年。
结合区域地貌和地表制图，对海成阶地残余进行对比关联。
通过断裂带形态的结构分析，计算正断层的垂直位移速率。
de: Luminescence dating samples collected from marine terraces ranging from ~100 to 1,000 meters above sea level (masl) in southern Calabria, Italy.
Geomorphic and structural maps of the terrace surfaces and active normal faults.
采集自意大利南部卡拉布里亚海拔约100至1000米海成阶地的光释光测年样品。
阶地表面及活动正断层的地貌与构造地质图。
li: Luminescence dating at high elevations can face challenges such as signal saturation or incomplete bleaching of marine sands.
The study relies on interpolation of highly fragmented erosional remnants, which introduces spatial uncertainty.
高海拔地区的光释光测年可能面临信号饱和或海相砂层晒度不完全等挑战。
研究依赖于高度破碎的侵蚀残余体的插值对比，这带来了一定的空间不确定性。

fig.title: Geomorphic and structural setting of luminescence samples
desc: This figure maps the distribution of marine terraces and active normal faults in southern Calabria, indicating where the shallow marine sand samples were collected for luminescence dating.
该图展示了南卡拉布里亚海成阶地和活动正断层的分布，标明了用于光释光测年的浅海砂样的采集位置和海拔。
interp: Demonstrates that the high-elevation terraces are erosional remnants of a single surface that has been severely deformed and uplifted post-120 ka.
表明高海拔阶地是单一表面的侵蚀残余，该表面在12万年前之后经历了剧烈的变形和抬升。
fig.finding: The samples span a wide elevation range from ~100 to 1,000 masl, yet map onto a single, once-continuous deformed surface.
fig.cap: Shows the geomorphic and structural map of southern Calabria, highlighting the locations and elevations of the dated luminescence samples.

fig.title: Schematic 3D view of torn slabs beneath southern Italy
desc: A 3D geodynamic visualization showing the subducting Ionian lithosphere, the location of the active slab tear, and how it drives mantle flow and isostatic uplift of the overlying crust in Calabria.
一个三维地球动力学可视化模型，展示了俯冲的伊奥尼亚岩石圈、活动板块撕裂的位置，以及它如何驱动地幔流和上覆卡拉布里亚地壳的等静压抬升。
interp: Links deep mantle/slab dynamics directly to rapid, transient surface deformation and associated seismic hazards.
将深部地幔/板块动力学与快速、瞬态的地表变形及相关的地震灾害直接联系起来。
fig.finding: The active slab tear beneath southern Calabria provides the buoyant, isostatic driving force for the observed rapid surface uplift.
fig.cap: Presents a 3D schematic model of the subducted Ionian slab and the active tear beneath southern Italy.

tm.why: The paper investigates rapid surface uplift as an isostatic response to an active tear in the subducted Ionian slab.
The findings on rapid uplift and active normal faulting have direct implications for assessing geohazards in a high seismic risk region.

ev.notes: Analysis is based on the detailed abstract and public web metadata including figure titles and captions retrieved via Google search.
